// lib/presentation/screens/accounting/chart_of_accounts/chart_of_accounts_screen.dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:provider/provider.dart';
import '../../../providers/accounting_provider.dart';
import '../../../domain/entities/account.dart';
import '../../../widgets/shared/loading_indicator.dart';
import 'create_account_screen.dart';
import 'account_detail_screen.dart';

class ChartOfAccountsScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const ChartOfAccountsScreen({super.key});

  @override
  State<ChartOfAccountsScreen> createState() => _ChartOfAccountsScreenState();
}

class _ChartOfAccountsScreenState extends State<ChartOfAccountsScreen> {
  String _searchQuery = '';
  String? _selectedType;
  bool _showInactive = false;
  List<Account> _accounts = [];
  bool _isLoading = true;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _loadAccounts();
  }

  Future<void> _loadAccounts() async {
    setState(() => _isLoading = true);
    try {
      final provider = context.read<AccountingProvider>();
      await provider.loadAccounts();
      _accounts = provider.accounts;
    } catch (e) {
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        SnackBar(content: Text('خطأ: $e'), backgroundColor: Colors.red),
      );
    } finally {
      setState(() => _isLoading = false);
    }
  }

  List<Account> _getFilteredAccounts() {
    var filtered = _accounts;

    // فلترة حسب النوع
    if (_selectedType != null) {
      filtered = filtered.where((a) => a.accountType == _selectedType).toList();
    }

    // فلترة حسب النشاط
    if (!_showInactive) {
      filtered = filtered.where((a) => a.isActive).toList();
    }

    // البحث
    if (_searchQuery.isNotEmpty) {
      final query = _searchQuery.toLowerCase();
      filtered = filtered.where((a) =>
          a.code.toLowerCase().contains(query) ||
          a.name.toLowerCase().contains(query) ||
          (a.description?.toLowerCase().contains(query) ?? false)).toList();
    }

    return filtered;
  }

  List<Account> _buildTree(List<Account> accounts) {
    // تجميع الحسابات حسب النوع
    final Map<String, List<Account>> grouped = {};
    for (var account in accounts) {
      grouped.putIfAbsent(account.accountType, () => []);
      grouped[account.accountType]!.add(account);
    }

    return accounts;
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(
        title: const Text('شجرة الحسابات'),
        centerTitle: true,
        bottom: PreferredSize(
          preferredSize: const Size.fromHeight(60),
          child: Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(8),
            child: Row(
              children: [
                Expanded(
                  child: TextField(
                    decoration: const InputDecoration(
                      hintText: 'بحث عن حساب...',
                      prefixIcon: Icon(Icons.search),
                      border: OutlineInputBorder(),
                      contentPadding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 8),
                    ),
                    onChanged: (value) => setState(() => _searchQuery = value),
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(width: 8),
                IconButton(
                  icon: Icon(
                    _showInactive ? Icons.visibility : Icons.visibility_off,
                    color: _showInactive ? Colors.blue : Colors.grey,
                  ),
                  onPressed: () => setState(() => _showInactive = !_showInactive),
                  tooltip: 'عرض الحسابات غير النشطة',
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
      body: _isLoading
          ? const LoadingIndicator()
          : Column(
              children: [
                // فلاتر النوع
                _buildTypeFilter(),
                // قائمة الحسابات
                Expanded(
                  child: _accounts.isEmpty
                      ? const Center(child: Text('لا توجد حسابات'))
                      : ListView.builder(
                          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(8),
                          itemCount: _getFilteredAccounts().length,
                          itemBuilder: (context, index) {
                            final account = _getFilteredAccounts()[index];
                            return _buildAccountTile(account);
                          },
                        ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
      floatingActionButton: FloatingActionButton(
        onPressed: () => _navigateToCreate(),
        child: const Icon(Icons.add),
        tooltip: 'إنشاء حساب جديد',
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildTypeFilter() {
    final types = [
      null,
      'asset',
      'liability',
      'equity',
      'revenue',
      'expense',
    ];
    final labels = [
      'الكل',
      'أصول',
      'خصوم',
      'حقوق ملكية',
      'إيرادات',
      'مصروفات',
    ];

    return Container(
      height: 50,
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8),
      child: ListView.builder(
        scrollDirection: Axis.horizontal,
        itemCount: types.length,
        itemBuilder: (context, index) {
          final isSelected = _selectedType == types[index];
          return Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 4),
            child: FilterChip(
              label: Text(labels[index]),
              selected: isSelected,
              onSelected: (_) => setState(() {
                _selectedType = isSelected ? null : types[index];
              }),
              backgroundColor: Colors.grey.shade200,
              selectedColor: Colors.blue.shade100,
              checkmarkColor: Colors.blue,
            ),
          );
        },
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildAccountTile(Account account) {
    return Card(
      margin: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 2),
      child: ListTile(
        leading: CircleAvatar(
          backgroundColor: account.typeColor.withOpacity(0.2),
          radius: 18,
          child: Icon(
            _getAccountIcon(account.accountType),
            color: account.typeColor,
            size: 18,
          ),
        ),
        title: Text(
          '${account.code} - ${account.name}',
          style: TextStyle(
            fontWeight: account.isActive ? FontWeight.normal : FontWeight.w300,
            color: account.isActive ? Colors.black : Colors.grey,
          ),
        ),
        subtitle: account.description != null
            ? Text(account.description!, maxLines: 1, overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis)
            : null,
        trailing: Row(
          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
          children: [
            if (account.balance != null)
              Container(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8, vertical: 4),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: Colors.grey.shade200,
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
                ),
                child: Text(
                  account.balance!.toStringAsFixed(2),
                  style: TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 12,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
                    color: account.balance! > Decimal.zero ? Colors.green : Colors.red,
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            if (!account.isActive)
              Container(
                margin: const EdgeInsets.only(left: 8),
                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 6, vertical: 2),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: Colors.grey.shade300,
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
                ),
                child: const Text(
                  'غير نشط',
                  style: TextStyle(fontSize: 10, color: Colors.grey),
                ),
              ),
            IconButton(
              icon: const Icon(Icons.chevron_right, size: 20),
              onPressed: () => _navigateToDetail(account),
            ),
          ],
        ),
        onTap: () => _navigateToDetail(account),
      ),
    );
  }

  IconData _getAccountIcon(String type) {
    switch (type) {
      case 'asset':
        return Icons.account_balance;
      case 'liability':
        return Icons.credit_card;
      case 'equity':
        return Icons.attach_money;
      case 'revenue':
        return Icons.trending_up;
      case 'expense':
        return Icons.trending_down;
      default:
        return Icons.account_balance_wallet;
    }
  }

  void _navigateToCreate() {
    Navigator.push(
      context,
      MaterialPageRoute(
        builder: (context) => const CreateAccountScreen(),
      ),
    ).then((_) => _loadAccounts());
  }

  void _navigateToDetail(Account account) {
    Navigator.push(
      context,
      MaterialPageRoute(
        builder: (context) => AccountDetailScreen(account: account),
      ),
    ).then((_) => _loadAccounts());
  }
}

// lib/presentation/screens/accounting/chart_of_accounts/create_account_screen.dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:provider/provider.dart';
import '../../../providers/accounting_provider.dart';
import '../../../domain/entities/account.dart';
import '../../../widgets/shared/loading_indicator.dart';

class CreateAccountScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  final Account? initialAccount;

  const CreateAccountScreen({super.key, this.initialAccount});

  @override
  State<CreateAccountScreen> createState() => _CreateAccountScreenState();
}

class _CreateAccountScreenState extends State<CreateAccountScreen> {
  final _formKey = GlobalKey<FormState>();
  final _codeController = TextEditingController();
  final _nameController = TextEditingController();
  final _descriptionController = TextEditingController();
  
  String _accountType = 'asset';
  String _currency = 'USD';
  String? _parentCode;
  bool _isActive = true;
  bool _isLoading = false;

  final List<Account> _accounts = [];

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    if (widget.initialAccount != null) {
      _codeController.text = widget.initialAccount!.code;
      _nameController.text = widget.initialAccount!.name;
      _descriptionController.text = widget.initialAccount!.description ?? '';
      _accountType = widget.initialAccount!.accountType;
      _currency = widget.initialAccount!.currency;
      _parentCode = widget.initialAccount!.parentCode;
      _isActive = widget.initialAccount!.isActive;
    }
    _loadAccounts();
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _codeController.dispose();
    _nameController.dispose();
    _descriptionController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  Future<void> _loadAccounts() async {
    try {
      final provider = context.read<AccountingProvider>();
      await provider.loadAccounts();
      _accounts.clear();
      _accounts.addAll(provider.accounts);
      setState(() {});
    } catch (e) {
      // تجاهل الأخطاء
    }
  }

  Future<void> _save() async {
    if (!_formKey.currentState!.validate()) return;

    setState(() => _isLoading = true);

    try {
      final provider = context.read<AccountingProvider>();
      
      if (widget.initialAccount != null) {
        // تحديث حساب موجود
        await provider.updateAccount(
          code: widget.initialAccount!.code,
          name: _nameController.text.trim(),
          accountType: _accountType,
          isActive: _isActive,
          parentCode: _parentCode,
          description: _descriptionController.text.trim(),
          currency: _currency,
        );
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          const SnackBar(content: Text('✅ تم تحديث الحساب بنجاح')),
        );
      } else {
        // إنشاء حساب جديد
        await provider.createAccount(
          code: _codeController.text.trim().toUpperCase(),
          name: _nameController.text.trim(),
          accountType: _accountType,
          parentCode: _parentCode,
          description: _descriptionController.text.trim(),
          currency: _currency,
        );
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          const SnackBar(content: Text('✅ تم إنشاء الحساب بنجاح')),
        );
      }

      if (mounted) Navigator.pop(context, true);
    } catch (e) {
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        SnackBar(
          content: Text('❌ خطأ: $e'),
          backgroundColor: Colors.red,
        ),
      );
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _isLoading = false);
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(
        title: Text(widget.initialAccount != null ? 'تعديل حساب' : 'حساب جديد'),
        actions: [
          TextButton(
            onPressed: _isLoading ? null : _save,
            child: Text(
              widget.initialAccount != null ? 'تحديث' : 'حفظ',
              style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.white),
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
      body: _isLoading
          ? const LoadingIndicator()
          : SingleChildScrollView(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
              child: Form(
                key: _formKey,
                child: Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                  children: [
                    // الكود
                    TextFormField(
                      controller: _codeController,
                      decoration: const InputDecoration(
                        labelText: 'كود الحساب *',
                        border: OutlineInputBorder(),
                        prefixIcon: Icon(Icons.code),
                        hintText: 'مثال: 1010',
                      ),
                      enabled: widget.initialAccount == null,
                      validator: (value) {
                        if (value == null || value.trim().isEmpty) {
                          return 'كود الحساب مطلوب';
                        }
                        if (value.trim().length < 3) {
                          return 'الكود يجب أن يكون 3 أحرف على الأقل';
                        }
                        return null;
                      },
                      textCapitalization: TextCapitalization.characters,
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 16),
                    // الاسم
                    TextFormField(
                      controller: _nameController,
                      decoration: const InputDecoration(
                        labelText: 'اسم الحساب *',
                        border: OutlineInputBorder(),
                        prefixIcon: Icon(Icons.account_balance),
                      ),
                      validator: (value) =>
                          value == null || value.trim().isEmpty ? 'اسم الحساب مطلوب' : null,
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 16),
                    // نوع الحساب
                    DropdownButtonFormField<String>(
                      value: _accountType,
                      decoration: const InputDecoration(
                        labelText: 'نوع الحساب *',
                        border: OutlineInputBorder(),
                        prefixIcon: Icon(Icons.category),
                      ),
                      items: const [
                        DropdownMenuItem(value: 'asset', child: Text('أصل (Asset)')),
                        DropdownMenuItem(value: 'liability', child: Text('خصم (Liability)')),
                        DropdownMenuItem(value: 'equity', child: Text('حقوق ملكية (Equity)')),
                        DropdownMenuItem(value: 'revenue', child: Text('إيراد (Revenue)')),
                        DropdownMenuItem(value: 'expense', child: Text('مصروف (Expense)')),
                      ],
                      onChanged: (value) => setState(() => _accountType = value!),
                      validator: (value) => value == null ? 'نوع الحساب مطلوب' : null,
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 16),
                    // العملة
                    DropdownButtonFormField<String>(
                      value: _currency,
                      decoration: const InputDecoration(
                        labelText: 'العملة',
                        border: OutlineInputBorder(),
                        prefixIcon: Icon(Icons.currency_exchange),
                      ),
                      items: const [
                        DropdownMenuItem(value: 'USD', child: Text('دولار أمريكي (USD)')),
                        DropdownMenuItem(value: 'LBP', child: Text('ليرة لبنانية (LBP)')),
                        DropdownMenuItem(value: 'EUR', child: Text('يورو (EUR)')),
                      ],
                      onChanged: (value) => setState(() => _currency = value!),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 16),
                    // الحساب الأب
                    DropdownButtonFormField<String>(
                      value: _parentCode,
                      decoration: const InputDecoration(
                        labelText: 'الحساب الأب (اختياري)',
                        border: OutlineInputBorder(),
                        prefixIcon: Icon(Icons.account_tree),
                      ),
                      items: [
                        const DropdownMenuItem(value: null, child: Text('لا يوجد')),
                        ..._accounts
                            .where((a) => a.code != _codeController.text.trim())
                            .map((account) => DropdownMenuItem(
                                  value: account.code,
                                  child: Text('${account.code} - ${account.name}'),
                                )),
                      ],
                      onChanged: (value) => setState(() => _parentCode = value),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 16),
                    // الوصف
                    TextFormField(
                      controller: _descriptionController,
                      decoration: const InputDecoration(
                        labelText: 'الوصف (اختياري)',
                        border: OutlineInputBorder(),
                        prefixIcon: Icon(Icons.description),
                      ),
                      maxLines: 3,
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 16),
                    // حالة النشاط
                    if (widget.initialAccount != null)
                      SwitchListTile(
                        title: const Text('الحساب نشط'),
                        value: _isActive,
                        onChanged: (value) => setState(() => _isActive = value),
                        activeColor: Colors.green,
                        secondary: Icon(
                          _isActive ? Icons.check_circle : Icons.cancel,
                          color: _isActive ? Colors.green : Colors.red,
                        ),
                      ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 24),
                    // أزرار الإجراءات
                    Row(
                      children: [
                        Expanded(
                          child: OutlinedButton(
                            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context),
                            child: const Text('إلغاء'),
                          ),
                        ),
                        const SizedBox(width: 12),
                        Expanded(
                          child: ElevatedButton(
                            onPressed: _save,
                            child: Text(widget.initialAccount != null ? 'تحديث' : 'إنشاء'),
                          ),
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ),
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:provider/provider.dart';
import 'package:intl/intl.dart';
import '../../providers/accounting_provider.dart';
import '../../../data/models/accounting/journal_line.dart';

class CreateJournalEntryScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const CreateJournalEntryScreen({super.key});

  @override
  State<CreateJournalEntryScreen> createState() => _CreateJournalEntryScreenState();
}

class _CreateJournalEntryScreenState extends State<CreateJournalEntryScreen> {
  final _formKey = GlobalKey<FormState>();
  final _descriptionController = TextEditingController();
  final _dateController = TextEditingController();
  
  DateTime _selectedDate = DateTime.now();
  List<JournalLineData> _lines = [];
  bool _isSaving = false;

  double get _totalDebit => _lines.fold(0, (sum, line) => sum + line.debit);
  double get _totalCredit => _lines.fold(0, (sum, line) => sum + line.credit);
  bool get _isBalanced => (_totalDebit - _totalCredit).abs() < 0.01;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _dateController.text = DateFormat('yyyy-MM-dd').format(_selectedDate);
    _addLine();
    _addLine();
    _loadAccounts();
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _descriptionController.dispose();
    _dateController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  Future<void> _loadAccounts() async {
    await context.read<AccountingProvider>().loadAccounts();
  }

  void _addLine() {
    setState(() {
      _lines.add(JournalLineData());
    });
  }

  void _removeLine(int index) {
    if (_lines.length <= 2) {
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        const SnackBar(
          content: Text('يجب أن يكون هناك سطرين على الأقل'),
          backgroundColor: Colors.orange,
        ),
      );
      return;
    }
    
    setState(() {
      _lines.removeAt(index);
    });
  }

  Future<void> _selectDate() async {
    final DateTime? picked = await showDatePicker(
      context: context,
      initialDate: _selectedDate,
      firstDate: DateTime(2020),
      lastDate: DateTime(2030),
    );
    
    if (picked != null) {
      setState(() {
        _selectedDate = picked;
        _dateController.text = DateFormat('yyyy-MM-dd').format(picked);
      });
    }
  }

  Future<void> _save({bool post = false}) async {
    if (!_formKey.currentState!.validate()) return;

    if (!_isBalanced) {
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        SnackBar(
          content: Text(
            '❌ القيد غير متوازن\nمدين: ${_totalDebit.toStringAsFixed(2)}\nدائن: ${_totalCredit.toStringAsFixed(2)}',
          ),
          backgroundColor: Colors.red,
        ),
      );
      return;
    }

    setState(() => _isSaving = true);

    try {
      final lines = _lines.map((line) => {
        'account_code': line.accountCode,
        'debit': line.debit,
        'credit': line.credit,
        if (line.description.isNotEmpty) 'description': line.description,
      }).toList();

      final success = await context.read<AccountingProvider>().createJournalEntry(
        date: _selectedDate,
        description: _descriptionController.text.trim(),
        lines: lines,
      );

      if (success && mounted) {
        Navigator.pop(context);
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          SnackBar(
            content: Text(post ? '✅ تم إنشاء وترحيل القيد بنجاح' : '✅ تم حفظ القيد كمسودة'),
            backgroundColor: Colors.green,
          ),
        );
      } else if (mounted) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          SnackBar(
            content: Text('❌ فشل في حفظ القيد: ${context.read<AccountingProvider>().error}'),
            backgroundColor: Colors.red,
          ),
        );
      }
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          SnackBar(
            content: Text('❌ خطأ: $e'),
            backgroundColor: Colors.red,
          ),
        );
      }
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _isSaving = false);
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(
        title: const Text('قيد يومي جديد'),
        backgroundColor: Colors.white,
        foregroundColor: Colors.black87,
        elevation: 0,
      ),
      body: Form(
        key: _formKey,
        child: Column(
          children: [
            Expanded(
              child: ListView(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
                children: [
                  // Date Field
                  TextFormField(
                    controller: _dateController,
                    readOnly: true,
                    onTap: _selectDate,
                    decoration: const InputDecoration(
                      labelText: 'التاريخ',
                      prefixIcon: Icon(Icons.calendar_today),
                      border: OutlineInputBorder(),
                    ),
                    validator: (value) {
                      if (value == null || value.isEmpty) {
                        return 'الرجاء اختيار التاريخ';
                      }
                      return null;
                    },
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 16),
                  
                  // Description Field
                  TextFormField(
                    controller: _descriptionController,
                    decoration: const InputDecoration(
                      labelText: 'البيان',
                      hintText: 'أدخل وصف القيد',
                      prefixIcon: Icon(Icons.description),
                      border: OutlineInputBorder(),
                    ),
                    maxLines: 2,
                    validator: (value) {
                      if (value == null || value.trim().isEmpty) {
                        return 'الرجاء إدخال البيان';
                      }
                      if (value.trim().length < 3) {
                        return 'البيان يجب أن يكون 3 أحرف على الأقل';
                      }
                      return null;
                    },
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 24),
                  
                  // Lines Header
                  Row(
                    children: [
                      const Text(
                        'الأسطر المحاسبية',
                        style: TextStyle(
                          fontSize: 18,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                        ),
                      ),
                      const Spacer(),
                      TextButton.icon(
                        onPressed: _addLine,
                        icon: const Icon(Icons.add),
                        label: const Text('إضافة سطر'),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 16),
                  
                  // Lines
                  ..._lines.asMap().entries.map((entry) {
                    final index = entry.key;
                    final line = entry.value;
                    return _buildLineItem(index, line);
                  }),
                  const SizedBox(height: 24),
                  
                  // Summary
                  _buildSummaryCard(),
                ],
              ),
            ),
            
            // Action Buttons
            Container(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: Colors.white,
                boxShadow: [
                  BoxShadow(
                    color: Colors.black.withOpacity(0.1),
                    blurRadius: 10,
                    offset: const Offset(0, -2),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
              child: Row(
                children: [
                  Expanded(
                    child: OutlinedButton(
                      onPressed: _isSaving ? null : () => _save(post: false),
                      style: OutlinedButton.styleFrom(
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 16),
                      ),
                      child: const Text('حفظ كمسودة'),
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(width: 16),
                  Expanded(
                    child: ElevatedButton(
                      onPressed: _isSaving ? null : () => _save(post: true),
                      style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 16),
                        backgroundColor: _isBalanced ? Colors.green : Colors.grey,
                      ),
                      child: _isSaving
                          ? const SizedBox(
                              height: 20,
                              width: 20,
                              child: CircularProgressIndicator(
                                strokeWidth: 2,
                                color: Colors.white,
                              ),
                            )
                          : const Text('حفظ وترحيل'),
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildLineItem(int index, JournalLineData line) {
    return Card(
      margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 12),
      elevation: 2,
      child: Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: [
            // Line Header
            Row(
              children: [
                CircleAvatar(
                  radius: 14,
                  child: Text('${index + 1}'),
                ),
                const SizedBox(width: 8),
                Text(
                  'سطر ${index + 1}',
                  style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
                ),
                const Spacer(),
                IconButton(
                  onPressed: () => _removeLine(index),
                  icon: const Icon(Icons.delete, color: Colors.red),
                  iconSize: 20,
                ),
              ],
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 12),
            
            // Account Code
            Consumer<AccountingProvider>(
              builder: (context, provider, child) {
                return DropdownButtonFormField<String>(
                  value: line.accountCode.isNotEmpty ? line.accountCode : null,
                  decoration: const InputDecoration(
                    labelText: 'الحساب',
                    border: OutlineInputBorder(),
                  ),
                  items: provider.accounts.map((account) {
                    return DropdownMenuItem(
                      value: account.code,
                      child: Text('${account.code} - ${account.name}'),
                    );
                  }).toList(),
                  onChanged: (value) {
                    setState(() {
                      _lines[index].accountCode = value ?? '';
                    });
                  },
                  validator: (value) {
                    if (value == null || value.isEmpty) {
                      return 'الرجاء اختيار الحساب';
                    }
                    return null;
                  },
                );
              },
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 12),
            
            // Debit and Credit
            Row(
              children: [
                Expanded(
                  child: TextFormField(
                    initialValue: line.debit > 0 ? line.debit.toString() : '',
                    keyboardType: TextInputType.number,
                    decoration: const InputDecoration(
                      labelText: 'مدين',
                      border: OutlineInputBorder(),
                      prefixIcon: Icon(Icons.arrow_downward),
                    ),
                    onChanged: (value) {
                      setState(() {
                        _lines[index].debit = double.tryParse(value) ?? 0;
                        if (_lines[index].debit > 0) {
                          _lines[index].credit = 0;
                        }
                      });
                    },
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(width: 12),
                Expanded(
                  child: TextFormField(
                    initialValue: line.credit > 0 ? line.credit.toString() : '',
                    keyboardType: TextInputType.number,
                    decoration: const InputDecoration(
                      labelText: 'دائن',
                      border: OutlineInputBorder(),
                      prefixIcon: Icon(Icons.arrow_upward),
                    ),
                    onChanged: (value) {
                      setState(() {
                        _lines[index].credit = double.tryParse(value) ?? 0;
                        if (_lines[index].credit > 0) {
                          _lines[index].debit = 0;
                        }
                      });
                    },
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 12),
            
            // Description
            TextFormField(
              initialValue: line.description,
              decoration: const InputDecoration(
                labelText: 'الوصف (اختياري)',
                border: OutlineInputBorder(),
              ),
              onChanged: (value) {
                setState(() {
                  _lines[index].description = value;
                });
              },
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildSummaryCard() {
    return Container(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: _isBalanced ? Colors.green.shade50 : Colors.red.shade50,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
        border: Border.all(
          color: _isBalanced ? Colors.green : Colors.red,
        ),
      ),
      child: Column(
        children: [
          Row(
            mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
            children: [
              const Text('إجمالي المدين:'),
              Text(
                _totalDebit.toStringAsFixed(2),
                style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
              ),
            ],
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 8),
          Row(
            mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
            children: [
              const Text('إجمالي الدائن:'),
              Text(
                _totalCredit.toStringAsFixed(2),
                style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
              ),
            ],
          ),
          const Divider(),
          Row(
            mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
            children: [
              Text(
                'الفرق:',
                style: TextStyle(
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                  color: _isBalanced ? Colors.green : Colors.red,
                ),
              ),
              Text(
                (_totalDebit - _totalCredit).toStringAsFixed(2),
                style: TextStyle(
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                  color: _isBalanced ? Colors.green : Colors.red,
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 8),
          Icon(
            _isBalanced ? Icons.check_circle : Icons.error,
            color: _isBalanced ? Colors.green : Colors.red,
            size: 32,
          ),
          Text(
            _isBalanced ? 'القيد متوازن' : 'القيد غير متوازن',
            style: TextStyle(
              color: _isBalanced ? Colors.green : Colors.red,
              fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

class JournalLineData {
  String accountCode = '';
  double debit = 0;
  double credit = 0;
  String description = '';
}

// frontend/lib/presentation/screens/accounting/fiscal_periods_screen.dart
/// شاشة إدارة الفترات المالية

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:provider/provider.dart';
import 'package:intl/intl.dart';
import '../../../core/theme/app_colors.dart';
import '../../providers/fiscal_period_provider.dart';
import '../../widgets/shared_widgets.dart';

class FiscalPeriodsScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const FiscalPeriodsScreen({super.key});

  @override
  State<FiscalPeriodsScreen> createState() => _FiscalPeriodsScreenState();
}

class _FiscalPeriodsScreenState extends State<FiscalPeriodsScreen> {
  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
      context.read<FiscalPeriodProvider>().loadPeriods();
    });
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(
        title: const Text('الفترات المالية'),
        centerTitle: true,
        actions: [
          IconButton(
            icon: const Icon(Icons.add),
            onPressed: () => _showCreatePeriodDialog(),
          ),
        ],
      ),
      body: Consumer<FiscalPeriodProvider>(
        builder: (context, provider, child) {
          if (provider.isLoading) {
            return const LoadingIndicator(message: 'جاري تحميل الفترات...');
          }
          if (provider.error != null) {
            return ErrorWidgetCustom(
              error: provider.error!,
              onRetry: () => provider.loadPeriods(),
            );
          }
          if (provider.periods.isEmpty) {
            return EmptyState(
              icon: Icons.calendar_month,
              title: 'لا توجد فترات مالية',
              subtitle: 'اضغط + لإنشاء فترة جديدة',
            );
          }
          return ListView.builder(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
            itemCount: provider.periods.length,
            itemBuilder: (context, index) {
              return _buildPeriodCard(provider.periods[index]);
            },
          );
        },
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildPeriodCard(dynamic period) {
    final dateFormat = DateFormat('yyyy/MM/dd');
    Color statusColor;
    String statusText;
    IconData statusIcon;

    switch (period.status) {
      case 'open':
        statusColor = AppColors.success;
        statusText = 'مفتوحة';
        statusIcon = Icons.lock_open;
        break;
      case 'closed':
        statusColor = AppColors.error;
        statusText = 'مغلقة';
        statusIcon = Icons.lock;
        break;
      case 'adjustment':
        statusColor = AppColors.warning;
        statusText = 'تعديل';
        statusIcon = Icons.edit_calendar;
        break;
      default:
        statusColor = Colors.grey;
        statusText = period.status;
        statusIcon = Icons.help;
    }

    return Card(
      margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 12),
      elevation: 2,
      shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12)),
      child: Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: [
            Row(
              children: [
                Container(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.all(10),
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: statusColor.withOpacity(0.1),
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                  ),
                  child: Icon(statusIcon, color: statusColor, size: 24),
                ),
                const SizedBox(width: 12),
                Expanded(
                  child: Column(
                    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                    children: [
                      Text(
                        period.name,
                        style: const TextStyle(
                          fontSize: 16,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                        ),
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(height: 4),
                      Text(
                        '${dateFormat.format(period.startDate)} - ${dateFormat.format(period.endDate)}',
                        style: TextStyle(
                          fontSize: 13,
                          color: Colors.grey.shade600,
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
                Container(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 10, vertical: 4),
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: statusColor.withOpacity(0.1),
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
                  ),
                  child: Text(
                    statusText,
                    style: TextStyle(color: statusColor, fontSize: 12),
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
            if (period.status == 'open') ...[
              const Divider(height: 24),
              Row(
                children: [
                  _buildActionButton(
                    context,
                    'إغلاق',
                    Icons.lock,
                    AppColors.error,
                    () => _closePeriod(period),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(width: 8),
                  _buildActionButton(
                    context,
                    'تعديل',
                    Icons.edit,
                    AppColors.warning,
                    () => _showEditPeriodDialog(period),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ],
            if (period.status == 'closed') ...[
              const Divider(height: 24),
              _buildActionButton(
                context,
                'إعادة فتح',
                Icons.lock_open,
                AppColors.primary,
                () => _reopenPeriod(period),
              ),
            ],
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildActionButton(
    BuildContext context,
    String label,
    IconData icon,
    Color color,
    VoidCallback onPressed,
  ) {
    return Expanded(
      child: OutlinedButton.icon(
        onPressed: onPressed,
        icon: Icon(icon, size: 18, color: color),
        label: Text(label, style: TextStyle(color: color)),
        style: OutlinedButton.styleFrom(
          side: BorderSide(color: color.withOpacity(0.5)),
          shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8)),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  // ==================== Actions ====================
  void _showCreatePeriodDialog() {
    showDialog(
      context: context,
      builder: (context) => const CreatePeriodDialog(),
    );
  }

  void _showEditPeriodDialog(dynamic period) {
    // TODO: تنفيذ تعديل الفترة
  }

  Future<void> _closePeriod(dynamic period) async {
    final confirm = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      builder: (context) => AlertDialog(
        title: const Text('إغلاق الفترة'),
        content: Text('هل أنت متأكد من إغلاق الفترة "${period.name}"؟\nلا يمكن إنشاء قيود جديدة في فترة مغلقة.'),
        actions: [
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context, false),
            child: const Text('إلغاء'),
          ),
          ElevatedButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context, true),
            style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(backgroundColor: AppColors.error),
            child: const Text('إغلاق'),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );

    if (confirm == true && mounted) {
      await context.read<FiscalPeriodProvider>().closePeriod(period.id);
    }
  }

  Future<void> _reopenPeriod(dynamic period) async {
    final confirm = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      builder: (context) => AlertDialog(
        title: const Text('إعادة فتح الفترة'),
        content: Text('هل أنت متأكد من إعادة فتح الفترة "${period.name}"؟'),
        actions: [
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context, false),
            child: const Text('إلغاء'),
          ),
          ElevatedButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context, true),
            child: const Text('إعادة فتح'),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );

    if (confirm == true && mounted) {
      await context.read<FiscalPeriodProvider>().reopenPeriod(period.id);
    }
  }
}

// ==================== Create Period Dialog ====================
class CreatePeriodDialog extends StatefulWidget {
  const CreatePeriodDialog({super.key});

  @override
  State<CreatePeriodDialog> createState() => _CreatePeriodDialogState();
}

class _CreatePeriodDialogState extends State<CreatePeriodDialog> {
  final _formKey = GlobalKey<FormState>();
  final _nameController = TextEditingController();
  DateTime? _startDate;
  DateTime? _endDate;
  String _periodType = 'monthly';

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _nameController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return AlertDialog(
      title: const Text('إنشاء فترة مالية جديدة'),
      content: Form(
        key: _formKey,
        child: SingleChildScrollView(
          child: Column(
            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
            children: [
              TextFormField(
                controller: _nameController,
                decoration: const InputDecoration(
                  labelText: 'اسم الفترة',
                  hintText: 'مثال: يناير 2026',
                ),
                validator: (v) => v!.isEmpty ? 'يرجى إدخال اسم الفترة' : null,
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 16),
              DropdownButtonFormField<String>(
                value: _periodType,
                decoration: const InputDecoration(labelText: 'نوع الفترة'),
                items: const [
                  DropdownMenuItem(value: 'monthly', child: Text('شهرية')),
                  DropdownMenuItem(value: 'quarterly', child: Text('ربع سنوية')),
                  DropdownMenuItem(value: 'yearly', child: Text('سنوية')),
                  DropdownMenuItem(value: 'adjustment', child: Text('تعديل')),
                ],
                onChanged: (v) => setState(() => _periodType = v!),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 16),
              _buildDatePicker('تاريخ البداية', _startDate, (date) {
                setState(() => _startDate = date);
              }),
              const SizedBox(height: 16),
              _buildDatePicker('تاريخ النهاية', _endDate, (date) {
                setState(() => _endDate = date);
              }),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
      actions: [
        TextButton(
          onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context),
          child: const Text('إلغاء'),
        ),
        ElevatedButton(
          onPressed: _createPeriod,
          child: const Text('إنشاء'),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }

  Widget _buildDatePicker(String label, DateTime? date, Function(DateTime) onChanged) {
    return InkWell(
      onTap: () async {
        final picked = await showDatePicker(
          context: context,
          initialDate: date ?? DateTime.now(),
          firstDate: DateTime(2020),
          lastDate: DateTime(2030),
        );
        if (picked != null) onChanged(picked);
      },
      child: InputDecorator(
        decoration: InputDecoration(
          labelText: label,
          suffixIcon: const Icon(Icons.calendar_today),
        ),
        child: Text(
          date != null ? DateFormat('yyyy/MM/dd').format(date) : 'اختر التاريخ',
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Future<void> _createPeriod() async {
    if (!_formKey.currentState!.validate()) return;
    if (_startDate == null || _endDate == null) {
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        const SnackBar(content: Text('يرجى تحديد تاريخ البداية والنهاية')),
      );
      return;
    }

    try {
      await context.read<FiscalPeriodProvider>().createPeriod(
        name: _nameController.text.trim(),
        startDate: _startDate!,
        endDate: _endDate!,
        periodType: _periodType,
      );
      if (mounted) {
        Navigator.pop(context);
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          const SnackBar(content: Text('✅ تم إنشاء الفترة بنجاح'), backgroundColor: Colors.green),
        );
      }
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          SnackBar(content: Text('❌ خطأ: $e'), backgroundColor: Colors.red),
        );
      }
    }
  }
}

// lib/presentation/screens/accounting/journal_entries/journal_entries_screen.dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:provider/provider.dart';
import 'package:intl/intl.dart';
import '../../../providers/accounting_provider.dart';
import '../../../widgets/shared/loading_indicator.dart';
import '../../../widgets/shared/empty_state.dart';
import 'widgets/journal_entry_card.dart';
import 'widgets/journal_entry_filter.dart';
import 'create_journal_entry_screen.dart';
import 'journal_entry_detail_screen.dart';

class JournalEntriesScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const JournalEntriesScreen({super.key});

  @override
  State<JournalEntriesScreen> createState() => _JournalEntriesScreenState();
}

class _JournalEntriesScreenState extends State<JournalEntriesScreen> {
  final ScrollController _scrollController = ScrollController();

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _loadData();
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _scrollController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _loadData() {
    WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
      context.read<AccountingProvider>().loadJournalEntries();
    });
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Scaffold(
      appBar: _buildAppBar(),
      body: Consumer<AccountingProvider>(
        builder: (context, provider, child) {
          if (provider.isLoading && provider.journalEntries.isEmpty) {
            return const LoadingIndicator(message: 'جاري تحميل القيود...');
          }

          if (provider.error != null && provider.journalEntries.isEmpty) {
            return _buildErrorWidget(provider.error!);
          }

          if (provider.journalEntries.isEmpty) {
            return EmptyState(
              icon: Icons.receipt_long,
              title: 'لا توجد قيود محاسبية',
              subtitle: 'قم بإنشاء أول قيد محاسبي',
              buttonText: 'إنشاء قيد',
              onPressed: () => _navigateToCreate(context),
            );
          }

          return Column(
            children: [
              // شريط الفلاتر السريع
              _buildFilterChips(provider),
              // قائمة القيود
              Expanded(
                child: RefreshIndicator(
                  onRefresh: () => _refresh(context),
                  child: ListView.builder(
                    controller: _scrollController,
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.all(8),
                    itemCount: provider.journalEntries.length,
                    itemBuilder: (context, index) {
                      final entry = provider.journalEntries[index];
                      return JournalEntryCard(
                        entry: entry,
                        onTap: () => _navigateToDetail(context, entry),
                        onRefresh: () => _refresh(context),
                      );
                    },
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ],
          );
        },
      ),
      floatingActionButton: FloatingActionButton(
        onPressed: () => _navigateToCreate(context),
        child: const Icon(Icons.add),
      ),
    );
  }

  PreferredSizeWidget _buildAppBar() {
    return AppBar(
      title: const Text('القيود اليومية'),
      centerTitle: true,
      actions: [
        // زر التصفية
        IconButton(
          icon: const Icon(Icons.filter_list),
          onPressed: () => _showFilterDialog(context),
        ),
        // زر التحديث
        IconButton(
          icon: const Icon(Icons.refresh),
          onPressed: () => _refresh(context),
        ),
        // زر الإحصائيات
        IconButton(
          icon: const Icon(Icons.bar_chart),
          onPressed: () => _showStatistics(context),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }

  Widget _buildFilterChips(AccountingProvider provider) {
    return SingleChildScrollView(
      scrollDirection: Axis.horizontal,
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 8),
      child: Row(
        children: [
          FilterChip(
            label: const Text('الكل'),
            selected: provider.statusFilter == null,
            onSelected: (_) => provider.setFilter(status: null),
          ),
          const SizedBox(width: 8),
          FilterChip(
            label: const Text('مسودة'),
            selected: provider.statusFilter == 'draft',
            onSelected: (_) => provider.setFilter(status: 'draft'),
          ),
          const SizedBox(width: 8),
          FilterChip(
            label: const Text('مرحلة'),
            selected: provider.statusFilter == 'posted',
            onSelected: (_) => provider.setFilter(status: 'posted'),
          ),
          const SizedBox(width: 8),
          FilterChip(
            label: const Text('معكوس'),
            selected: provider.statusFilter == 'reversed',
            onSelected: (_) => provider.setFilter(status: 'reversed'),
          ),
          if (provider.hasFilters) ...[
            const SizedBox(width: 8),
            ActionChip(
              label: const Text('إلغاء الفلترة'),
              onPressed: provider.clearFilters,
              backgroundColor: Colors.grey.shade200,
            ),
          ],
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildErrorWidget(String error) {
    return Center(
      child: Column(
        mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
        children: [
          const Icon(Icons.error_outline, size: 64, color: Colors.red),
          const SizedBox(height: 16),
          Text(
            error,
            style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.red),
            textAlign: TextAlign.center,
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 16),
          ElevatedButton(
            onPressed: () => _refresh(context),
            child: const Text('إعادة المحاولة'),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  void _showFilterDialog(BuildContext context) {
    showModalBottomSheet(
      context: context,
      isScrollControlled: true,
      builder: (context) => JournalEntryFilter(
        onApply: (filters) {
          context.read<AccountingProvider>().setFilter(
            status: filters['status'],
            fromDate: filters['fromDate'],
            toDate: filters['toDate'],
            userId: filters['userId'],
          );
        },
        onClear: () {
          context.read<AccountingProvider>().clearFilters();
        },
      ),
    );
  }

  void _showStatistics(BuildContext context) {
    // عرض إحصائيات القيود
    showDialog(
      context: context,
      builder: (context) => AlertDialog(
        title: const Text('إحصائيات القيود'),
        content: Consumer<AccountingProvider>(
          builder: (context, provider, child) {
            final total = provider.journalEntries.length;
            final posted = provider.journalEntries.where((e) => e.isPosted).length;
            final draft = provider.journalEntries.where((e) => e.isDraft).length;
            final reversed = provider.journalEntries.where((e) => e.isReversed).length;

            return Column(
              mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              children: [
                _buildStatRow('الإجمالي', total.toString(), Colors.blue),
                const Divider(),
                _buildStatRow('مرحلة', posted.toString(), Colors.green),
                _buildStatRow('مسودة', draft.toString(), Colors.orange),
                _buildStatRow('معكوس', reversed.toString(), Colors.red),
              ],
            );
          },
        ),
        actions: [
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context),
            child: const Text('إغلاق'),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildStatRow(String label, String value, Color color) {
    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 4),
      child: Row(
        mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
        children: [
          Text(label, style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 16)),
          Container(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 4),
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
              color: color.withOpacity(0.2),
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
            ),
            child: Text(
              value,
              style: TextStyle(
                fontSize: 16,
                fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                color: color,
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Future<void> _refresh(BuildContext context) async {
    await context.read<AccountingProvider>().loadJournalEntries();
  }

  void _navigateToCreate(BuildContext context) {
    Navigator.push(
      context,
      MaterialPageRoute(
        builder: (context) => const CreateJournalEntryScreen(),
      ),
    ).then((_) => _refresh(context));
  }

  void _navigateToDetail(BuildContext context, JournalEntry entry) {
    Navigator.push(
      context,
      MaterialPageRoute(
        builder: (context) => JournalEntryDetailScreen(entry: entry),
      ),
    ).then((_) => _refresh(context));
  }
}

class JournalEntryDetailScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  final JournalEntry entry;

  const JournalEntryDetailScreen({
    super.key,
    required this.entry,
  });

  @override
  State<JournalEntryDetailScreen> createState() => _JournalEntryDetailScreenState();
}

class _JournalEntryDetailScreenState extends State<JournalEntryDetailScreen> {
  bool _isLoading = false;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(
        title: Text('تفاصيل القيد ${widget.entry.number ?? ''}'),
        actions: [
          // إجراءات القيد
          _buildActions(context),
        ],
      ),
      body: _isLoading
          ? const LoadingIndicator()
          : SingleChildScrollView(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
              child: Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: [
                  // المعلومات الأساسية
                  _buildBasicInfo(),
                  const SizedBox(height: 16),
                  // الأسطر
                  _buildLinesTable(),
                  const SizedBox(height: 16),
                  // ملخص
                  _buildSummary(),
                  if (widget.entry.isReversed) ...[
                    const SizedBox(height: 16),
                    _buildReversalInfo(),
                  ],
                ],
              ),
            ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildActions(BuildContext context) {
    final entry = widget.entry;

    if (entry.isPosted) {
      // قيد مرحل: يمكن عكسه فقط
      return Row(
        children: [
          IconButton(
            icon: const Icon(Icons.undo),
            onPressed: () => _showReverseDialog(context),
            tooltip: 'عكس القيد',
          ),
          IconButton(
            icon: const Icon(Icons.print),
            onPressed: () => _printEntry(),
            tooltip: 'طباعة',
          ),
        ],
      );
    } else if (entry.isReversed) {
      // قيد معكوس: لا يمكن فعل شيء
      return IconButton(
        icon: const Icon(Icons.info_outline),
        onPressed: () => _showReversedInfo(context),
        tooltip: 'هذا القيد معكوس',
      );
    } else {
      // قيد مسودة: يمكن تعديله أو حذفه
      return Row(
        children: [
          IconButton(
            icon: const Icon(Icons.edit),
            onPressed: () => _navigateToEdit(context),
            tooltip: 'تعديل القيد',
          ),
          IconButton(
            icon: const Icon(Icons.delete_outline, color: Colors.red),
            onPressed: () => _showDeleteDialog(context),
            tooltip: 'حذف القيد',
          ),
        ],
      );
    }
  }

  Widget _buildBasicInfo() {
    final entry = widget.entry;

    return Card(
      elevation: 2,
      child: Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: [
            Row(
              children: [
                Expanded(
                  child: _buildInfoRow('رقم القيد', entry.number ?? 'مسودة'),
                ),
                Expanded(
                  child: _buildInfoRow('التاريخ', DateFormat('yyyy-MM-dd').format(entry.date)),
                ),
              ],
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 8),
            Row(
              children: [
                Expanded(
                  child: _buildInfoRow('الحالة', entry.statusDisplay),
                ),
                Expanded(
                  child: _buildInfoRow('نوع الحركة', entry.transactionType ?? '-'),
                ),
              ],
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 8),
            _buildInfoRow('الوصف', entry.description),
            if (entry.createdBy != null) ...[
              const SizedBox(height: 8),
              _buildInfoRow('منشئ القيد', entry.createdBy!),
            ],
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildInfoRow(String label, String value) {
    return Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
      children: [
        Text(
          label,
          style: TextStyle(fontSize: 11, color: Colors.grey.shade600),
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: 2),
        Text(
          value,
          style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 14, fontWeight: FontWeight.w500),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }

  Widget _buildLinesTable() {
    return Card(
      elevation: 2,
      child: Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: [
            const Text(
              'أسطر القيد',
              style: TextStyle(fontSize: 16, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 8),
            Table(
              border: TableBorder.all(color: Colors.grey.shade300),
              columnWidths: const {
                0: FlexColumnWidth(2),
                1: FlexColumnWidth(1),
                2: FlexColumnWidth(1),
                3: FlexColumnWidth(1),
              },
              children: [
                // رأس الجدول
                const TableRow(
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(color: Colors.grey.shade200),
                  children: [
                    Padding(padding: EdgeInsets.all(8), child: Text('الحساب', style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold))),
                    Padding(padding: EdgeInsets.all(8), child: Text('المدين', style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold))),
                    Padding(padding: EdgeInsets.all(8), child: Text('الدائن', style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold))),

  void _showReverseDialog(BuildContext context) {
    final controller = TextEditingController();

    showDialog(
      context: context,
      builder: (context) => AlertDialog(
        title: const Text('عكس القيد'),
        content: Column(
          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
          children: [
            const Text('هل أنت متأكد من رغبتك في عكس هذا القيد؟'),
            const SizedBox(height: 12),
            TextField(
              controller: controller,
              decoration: const InputDecoration(
                labelText: 'سبب العكس',
                border: OutlineInputBorder(),
                hintText: 'سبب عكس القيد...',
              ),
              maxLines: 3,
            ),
          ],
        ),
        actions: [
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context),
            child: const Text('إلغاء'),
          ),
          ElevatedButton.icon(
            onPressed: () => _reverseEntry(context, controller.text),
            icon: const Icon(Icons.undo),
            label: const Text('عكس القيد'),
            style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(backgroundColor: Colors.orange),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Future<void> _reverseEntry(BuildContext context, String reason) async {
    setState(() => _isLoading = true);
    try {
      final provider = context.read<AccountingProvider>();
      await provider.reverseJournalEntry(
        id: widget.entry.id,
        reason: reason.isEmpty ? 'عكس قيد' : reason,
        reversedBy: 'system', // سيتم استبداله
      );
      
      if (mounted) {
        Navigator.pop(context);
        Navigator.pop(context, true); // العودة مع تحديث
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          const SnackBar(
            content: Text('✅ تم عكس القيد بنجاح'),
            backgroundColor: Colors.green,
          ),
        );
      }
    } catch (e) {
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        SnackBar(
          content: Text('❌ خطأ في عكس القيد: $e'),
          backgroundColor: Colors.red,
        ),
      );
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _isLoading = false);
    }
  }

  void _showDeleteDialog(BuildContext context) {
    showDialog(
      context: context,
      builder: (context) => AlertDialog(
        title: const Text('حذف القيد'),
        content: const Text('هل أنت متأكد من رغبتك في حذف هذا القيد المسودة؟'),
        actions: [
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context),
            child: const Text('إلغاء'),
          ),
          ElevatedButton.icon(
            onPressed: () => _deleteEntry(context),
            icon: const Icon(Icons.delete),
            label: const Text('حذف'),
            style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(backgroundColor: Colors.red),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Future<void> _deleteEntry(BuildContext context) async {
    setState(() => _isLoading = true);
    try {
      final provider = context.read<AccountingProvider>();
      await provider.deleteDraftJournalEntry(widget.entry.id);
      
      if (mounted) {
        Navigator.pop(context);
        Navigator.pop(context, true);
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          const SnackBar(
            content: Text('✅ تم حذف القيد'),
            backgroundColor: Colors.green,
          ),
        );
      }
    } catch (e) {
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        SnackBar(
          content: Text('❌ خطأ في الحذف: $e'),
          backgroundColor: Colors.red,
        ),
      );
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _isLoading = false);
    }
  }

  void _navigateToEdit(BuildContext context) {
    // سيتم تنفيذها في مرحلة لاحقة
  }

  void _printEntry() {
    // طباعة القيد
  }

  void _showReversedInfo(BuildContext context) {
    showDialog(
      context: context,
      builder: (context) => AlertDialog(
        title: const Text('قيد معكوس'),
        content: const Text(
          'هذا القيد تم عكسه ولا يمكن تعديله أو ترحيله مرة أخرى. '
          'لعكس عملية العكس، يمكنك إنشاء قيد جديد.',
        ),
        actions: [
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context),
            child: const Text('فهمت'),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

// lib/presentation/screens/accounting/journal_entries/widgets/journal_entry_card.dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:intl/intl.dart';
import '../../../../../domain/entities/journal_entry.dart';

class JournalEntryCard extends StatelessWidget {
  final JournalEntry entry;
  final VoidCallback onTap;
  final VoidCallback onRefresh;

  const JournalEntryCard({
    super.key,
    required this.entry,
    required this.onTap,
    required this.onRefresh,
  });

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final isPosted = entry.isPosted;
    final isReversed = entry.isReversed;
    final isDraft = entry.isDraft;

    Color statusColor;
    IconData statusIcon;
    String statusText;

    if (isPosted) {
      statusColor = Colors.green;
      statusIcon = Icons.check_circle;
      statusText = 'مرحلة';
    } else if (isReversed) {
      statusColor = Colors.orange;
      statusIcon = Icons.undo;
      statusText = 'معكوس';
    } else {
      statusColor = Colors.blue;
      statusIcon = Icons.edit;
      statusText = 'مسودة';
    }

    return Card(
      margin: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8, vertical: 4),
      elevation: 2,
      child: InkWell(
        onTap: onTap,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
        child: Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
          child: Column(
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
            children: [
              // الصف العلوي: الرقم والوصف والحالة
              Row(
                children: [
                  // حالة القيد
                  CircleAvatar(
                    radius: 16,
                    backgroundColor: statusColor.withOpacity(0.2),
                    child: Icon(statusIcon, size: 18, color: statusColor),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(width: 12),
                  // الرقم والوصف
                  Expanded(
                    child: Column(
                      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                      children: [
                        Text(
                          entry.number ?? 'مسودة',
                          style: const TextStyle(
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                            fontSize: 14,
                          ),
                        ),
                        Text(
                          entry.description,
                          maxLines: 1,
                          overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                          style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 12),
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),
                  // الحالة
                  Container(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 10, vertical: 4),
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                      color: statusColor.withOpacity(0.15),
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                    ),
                    child: Text(
                      statusText,
                      style: TextStyle(
                        color: statusColor,
                        fontSize: 12,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 8),
              // الصف السفلي: التاريخ والمبالغ
              Row(
                children: [
                  Icon(Icons.calendar_today, size: 14, color: Colors.grey.shade600),
                  const SizedBox(width: 4),
                  Text(
                    DateFormat('yyyy-MM-dd').format(entry.date),
                    style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12, color: Colors.grey.shade600),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(width: 16),
                  Container(
                    width: 1,
                    height: 16,
                    color: Colors.grey.shade300,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(width: 16),
                  Text(
                    'مدين: ${entry.totalDebit.toStringAsFixed(2)}',
                    style: const TextStyle(
                      fontSize: 12,
                      color: Colors.green,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(width: 8),
                  Text(
                    'دائن: ${entry.totalCredit.toStringAsFixed(2)}',
                    style: const TextStyle(
                      fontSize: 12,
                      color: Colors.red,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
                    ),
                  ),
                  const Spacer(),
                  // عدد الأسطر
                  Container(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8, vertical: 2),
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                      color: Colors.grey.shade200,
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
                    ),
                    child: Text(
                      '${entry.lines.length} أسطر',
                      style: TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 10,
                        color: Colors.grey.shade700,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );

// lib/presentation/screens/accounting/journal_entries/widgets/journal_entry_filter.dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:intl/intl.dart';

class JournalEntryFilter extends StatefulWidget {
  final Function(Map<String, dynamic>) onApply;
  final VoidCallback onClear;

  const JournalEntryFilter({
    super.key,
    required this.onApply,
    required this.onClear,
  });

  @override
  State<JournalEntryFilter> createState() => _JournalEntryFilterState();
}

class _JournalEntryFilterState extends State<JournalEntryFilter> {
  String? _status;
  DateTime? _fromDate;
  DateTime? _toDate;
  String? _userId;
  final _fromDateController = TextEditingController();
  final _toDateController = TextEditingController();
  final _userIdController = TextEditingController();

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _fromDateController.dispose();
    _toDateController.dispose();
    _userIdController.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Container(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
      child: Column(
        mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
        children: [
          // العنوان
          Row(
            children: [
              const Icon(Icons.filter_list, color: Colors.blue),
              const SizedBox(width: 8),
              const Text(
                'تصفية القيود',
                style: TextStyle(fontSize: 18, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
              ),
              const Spacer(),
              TextButton(
                onPressed: () {
                  _clearFilters();
                  widget.onClear();
                  Navigator.pop(context);
                },
                child: const Text('إلغاء الكل'),
              ),
            ],
          ),
          const Divider(),
          // الحالة
          DropdownButtonFormField<String>(
            value: _status,
            decoration: const InputDecoration(
              labelText: 'الحالة',
              border: OutlineInputBorder(),
              prefixIcon: Icon(Icons.flag),
            ),
            items: const [
              DropdownMenuItem(value: null, child: Text('الكل')),
              DropdownMenuItem(value: 'draft', child: Text('مسودة')),
              DropdownMenuItem(value: 'posted', child: Text('مرحلة')),
              DropdownMenuItem(value: 'reversed', child: Text('معكوس')),
            ],
            onChanged: (value) => setState(() => _status = value),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 12),
          // نطاق التاريخ
          Row(
            children: [
              Expanded(
                child: TextFormField(
                  controller: _fromDateController,
                  readOnly: true,
                  decoration: const InputDecoration(
                    labelText: 'من تاريخ',
                    border: OutlineInputBorder(),
                    prefixIcon: Icon(Icons.calendar_today),
                  ),
                  onTap: () => _selectDate(context, true),
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(width: 12),
              Expanded(
                child: TextFormField(
                  controller: _toDateController,
                  readOnly: true,
                  decoration: const InputDecoration(
                    labelText: 'إلى تاريخ',
                    border: OutlineInputBorder(),
                    prefixIcon: Icon(Icons.calendar_today),
                  ),
                  onTap: () => _selectDate(context, false),
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 12),
          // المستخدم
          TextFormField(
            controller: _userIdController,
            decoration: const InputDecoration(
              labelText: 'المستخدم',
              border: OutlineInputBorder(),
              prefixIcon: Icon(Icons.person),
              hintText: 'معرف المستخدم',
            ),
            onChanged: (value) => _userId = value,
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 16),
          // أزرار الإجراءات
          Row(
            children: [
              Expanded(
                child: OutlinedButton(
                  onPressed: () {
                    _clearFilters();
                    Navigator.pop(context);
                  },
                  child: const Text('إلغاء'),
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(width: 12),
              Expanded(
                child: ElevatedButton(
                  onPressed: () {
                    widget.onApply({
                      'status': _status,
                      'fromDate': _fromDate,
                      'toDate': _toDate,
                      'userId': _userId,
                    });
                    Navigator.pop(context);
                  },
                  child: const Text('تطبيق'),
                ),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Future<void> _selectDate(BuildContext context, bool isFrom) async {
    final now = DateTime.now();
    final picked = await showDatePicker(
      context: context,
      initialDate: isFrom ? (_fromDate ?? now) : (_toDate ?? now),
      firstDate: DateTime(2000),
      lastDate: DateTime(2100),
      locale: const Locale('ar'),
    );
    if (picked != null) {
      setState(() {
        if (isFrom) {
          _fromDate = picked;
          _fromDateController.text = DateFormat('yyyy-MM-dd').format(picked);
        } else {
          _toDate = picked;
          _toDateController.text = DateFormat('yyyy-MM-dd').format(picked);
        }
      });
    }
  }

  void _clearFilters() {
    setState(() {
      _status = null;
      _fromDate = null;
      _toDate = null;
      _userId = null;
      _fromDateController.clear();
      _toDateController.clear();
      _userIdController.clear();
    });
  }
}
