// lib/presentation/screens/funds/funds_screen.dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:provider/provider.dart';
import 'package:intl/intl.dart';
import '../../providers/funds_provider.dart';
import '../../domain/entities/fund.dart';
import '../../widgets/shared/loading_indicator.dart';
import 'create_fund_screen.dart';
import 'fund_detail_screen.dart';
import 'fund_transfer_screen.dart';

class FundsScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const FundsScreen({super.key});

  @override
  State<FundsScreen> createState() => _FundsScreenState();
}

class _FundsScreenState extends State<FundsScreen> {
  String _searchQuery = '';
  String? _selectedType;
  bool _showInactive = false;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _loadData();
  }

  void _loadData() {
    WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
      context.read<FundsProvider>().loadFunds();
    });
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(
        title: const Text('الصناديق النقدية'),
        centerTitle: true,
        bottom: PreferredSize(
          preferredSize: const Size.fromHeight(60),
          child: Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(8),
            child: Row(
              children: [
                Expanded(
                  child: TextField(
                    decoration: const InputDecoration(
                      hintText: 'بحث عن صندوق...',
                      prefixIcon: Icon(Icons.search),
                      border: OutlineInputBorder(),
                      contentPadding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 8),
                    ),
                    onChanged: (value) => setState(() => _searchQuery = value),
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(width: 8),
                IconButton(
                  icon: Icon(
                    _showInactive ? Icons.visibility : Icons.visibility_off,
                    color: _showInactive ? Colors.blue : Colors.grey,
                  ),
                  onPressed: () => setState(() => _showInactive = !_showInactive),
                  tooltip: 'عرض الصناديق غير النشطة',
                ),
                IconButton(
                  icon: const Icon(Icons.refresh),
                  onPressed: _loadData,
                  tooltip: 'تحديث',
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
      body: Consumer<FundsProvider>(
        builder: (context, provider, child) {
          if (provider.isLoading && provider.funds.isEmpty) {
            return const LoadingIndicator(message: 'جاري تحميل الصناديق...');
          }

          if (provider.error != null && provider.funds.isEmpty) {
            return _buildErrorWidget(provider.error!);
          }

          final filtered = _getFilteredFunds(provider.funds);

          if (filtered.isEmpty) {
            return _buildEmptyWidget();
          }

          return Column(
            children: [
              // إحصائيات سريعة
              _buildQuickStats(provider),
              // قائمة الصناديق
              Expanded(
                child: ListView.builder(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.all(8),
                  itemCount: filtered.length,
                  itemBuilder: (context, index) {
                    final fund = filtered[index];
                    return _buildFundCard(fund);
                  },
                ),
              ),
            ],
          );
        },
      ),
      floatingActionButton: Column(
        mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.end,
        children: [
          FloatingActionButton(
            heroTag: 'transfer',
            onPressed: () => _navigateToTransfer(),
            child: const Icon(Icons.swap_horiz),
            backgroundColor: Colors.orange,
            tooltip: 'تحويل بين الصناديق',
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 12),
          FloatingActionButton(
            heroTag: 'add',
            onPressed: () => _navigateToCreate(),
            child: const Icon(Icons.add),
            tooltip: 'صندوق جديد',
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildQuickStats(FundsProvider provider) {
    final stats = provider.getStatistics();
    
    return Container(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
      color: Colors.grey.shade50,
      child: Row(
        mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceAround,
        children: [
          _buildStatItem(
            'إجمالي الصناديق',
            stats['total'].toString(),
            Colors.blue,
          ),
          _buildStatItem(
            'نشطة',
            stats['active'].toString(),
            Colors.green,
          ),
          _buildStatItem(
            'إجمالي الرصيد',
            '${stats['totalBalance'].toStringAsFixed(2)}',
            Colors.purple,
            isCurrency: true,
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildStatItem(String label, String value, Color color, {bool isCurrency = false}) {
    return Column(
      children: [
        Text(
          label,
          style: TextStyle(fontSize: 11, color: Colors.grey.shade600),
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: 4),
        Text(
          isCurrency ? '$value USD' : value,
          style: TextStyle(
            fontSize: 16,
            fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
            color: color,
          ),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }

  List<Fund> _getFilteredFunds(List<Fund> funds) {
    var filtered = funds;

    if (!_showInactive) {
      filtered = filtered.where((f) => f.isActive).toList();
    }

    if (_selectedType != null) {
      filtered = filtered.where((f) => f.fundType == _selectedType).toList();
    }

    if (_searchQuery.isNotEmpty) {
      final query = _searchQuery.toLowerCase();
      filtered = filtered.where((f) =>
          f.code.toLowerCase().contains(query) ||
          f.name.toLowerCase().contains(query) ||
          f.accountCode.toLowerCase().contains(query));
    }

    return filtered;
  }

  Widget _buildFundCard(Fund fund) {
    final isLowBalance = fund.isLowBalance;
    final isHighBalance = fund.isHighBalance;

    return Card(
      margin: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 4, horizontal: 8),
      elevation: 2,
      child: InkWell(
        onTap: () => _navigateToDetail(fund),
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
        child: Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
          child: Column(
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
            children: [
              // الصف العلوي
              Row(
                children: [
                  Container(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8, vertical: 4),
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                      color: fund.statusColor.withOpacity(0.2),
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
                    ),
                    child: Text(
                      fund.statusDisplay,
                      style: TextStyle(
                        color: fund.statusColor,
                        fontSize: 11,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(width: 8),
                  Text(
                    fund.code,
                    style: const TextStyle(
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                      fontSize: 14,
                    ),
                  ),
                  const Spacer(),
                  // مؤشر الرصيد
                  if (isLowBalance)
                    Container(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 6, vertical: 2),
                      decoration: BoxDecoration(
                        color: Colors.red.shade50,
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
                        border: Border.all(color: Colors.red.shade300),
                      ),
                      child: const Text(
                        'رصيد منخفض',
                        style: TextStyle(fontSize: 10, color: Colors.red),
                      ),
                    ),
                  if (isHighBalance)
                    Container(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 6, vertical: 2),
                      decoration: BoxDecoration(
                        color: Colors.orange.shade50,
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
                        border: Border.all(color: Colors.orange.shade300),
                      ),
                      child: const Text(
                        'رصيد مرتفع',
                        style: TextStyle(fontSize: 10, color: Colors.orange),
                      ),
                    ),
                ],
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 8),
              // اسم الصندوق
              Text(
                fund.name,
                style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 16, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 8),
              // الرصيد والمعلومات
              Row(
                children: [
                  Expanded(
                    child: Column(
                      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                      children: [
                        Text(
                          'الرصيد الحالي',
                          style: TextStyle(fontSize: 11, color: Colors.grey.shade600),
                        ),
                        Text(
                          '${fund.balance.toStringAsFixed(2)} ${fund.currency}',
                          style: TextStyle(
                            fontSize: 18,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                            color: fund.balance > 0 ? Colors.green : Colors.red,
                          ),
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),
                  Expanded(
                    child: Column(
                      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                      children: [
                        Text(
                          'الحساب المحاسبي',
                          style: TextStyle(fontSize: 11, color: Colors.grey.shade600),
                        ),
                        Text(
                          fund.accountCode,
                          style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 14, fontWeight: FontWeight.w500),
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 8),
              // الحدود
              Row(
                children: [
                  if (fund.dailyLimit > 0)
                    _buildLimitChip('الحد اليومي', fund.dailyLimit, fund.currency),
                  if (fund.monthlyLimit > 0)
                    _buildLimitChip('الحد الشهري', fund.monthlyLimit, fund.currency),
                ],
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildLimitChip(String label, Decimal limit, String currency) {
    return Container(
      margin: const EdgeInsets.only(right: 8),
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 6, vertical: 2),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: Colors.grey.shade200,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
      ),
      child: Text(
        '$label: ${limit.toStringAsFixed(2)} $currency',
        style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 10, color: Colors.grey),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildErrorWidget(String error) {
    return Center(
      child: Column(
        mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
        children: [
          const Icon(Icons.error_outline, size: 64, color: Colors.red),
          const SizedBox(height: 16),
          Text(error, style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.red)),
          const SizedBox(height: 16),
          ElevatedButton(
            onPressed: _loadData,
            child: const Text('إعادة المحاولة'),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildEmptyWidget() {
    return Center(
      child: Column(
        mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
        children: [
          Icon(Icons.account_balance_wallet, size: 64, color: Colors.grey.shade400),
          const SizedBox(height: 16),
          const Text(
            'لا توجد صناديق',
            style: TextStyle(fontSize: 18, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 8),
          const Text(
            'قم بإنشاء صندوق جديد',
            style: TextStyle(color: Colors.grey.shade600),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 16),
          ElevatedButton(
            onPressed: _navigateToCreate,
            child: const Text('إنشاء صندوق جديد'),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  void _navigateToCreate() {
    Navigator.push(
      context,
      MaterialPageRoute(
        builder: (context) => const CreateFundScreen(),
      ),
    ).then((_) => _loadData());
  }

  void _navigateToDetail(Fund fund) {
    Navigator.push(
      context,
      MaterialPageRoute(
        builder: (context) => FundDetailScreen(fund: fund),
      ),
    ).then((_) => _loadData());
  }

  void _navigateToTransfer() {
    Navigator.push(
      context,
      MaterialPageRoute(
        builder: (context) => const FundTransferScreen(),
      ),
    ).then((_) => _loadData());
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:provider/provider.dart';
import '../../providers/auth_provider.dart';
import '../dashboard/dashboard_screen.dart';
import '../accounting/journal_entry_list_screen.dart';
import '../invoices/invoice_list_screen.dart';
import '../payments/payment_list_screen.dart';
import '../reports/reports_screen.dart';
import '../settings/settings_screen.dart';
import '../auth/login_screen.dart';

class HomeScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const HomeScreen({super.key});

  @override
  State<HomeScreen> createState() => _HomeScreenState();
}

class _HomeScreenState extends State<HomeScreen> {
  int _currentIndex = 0;

  final List<Widget> _screens = [
    const DashboardScreen(),
    const JournalEntryListScreen(),
    const InvoiceListScreen(),
    const PaymentListScreen(),
    const ReportsScreen(),
  ];

  final List<NavigationItem> _navigationItems = [
    NavigationItem(icon: Icons.dashboard, label: 'الرئيسية'),
    NavigationItem(icon: Icons.book, label: 'القيود'),
    NavigationItem(icon: Icons.receipt, label: 'الفواتير'),
    NavigationItem(icon: Icons.payment, label: 'الدفعات'),
    NavigationItem(icon: Icons.bar_chart, label: 'التقارير'),
  ];

  void _logout() async {
    final confirmed = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      builder: (context) => AlertDialog(
        title: const Text('تسجيل الخروج'),
        content: const Text('هل أنت متأكد من تسجيل الخروج؟'),
        actions: [
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context, false),
            child: const Text('إلغاء'),
          ),
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context, true),
            child: const Text('خروج', style: TextStyle(color: Colors.red)),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );

    if (confirmed == true && mounted) {
      await context.read<AuthProvider>().logout();
      if (mounted) {
        Navigator.pushReplacement(
          context,
          MaterialPageRoute(builder: (_) => const LoginScreen()),
        );
      }
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(
        title: Row(
          children: [
            Icon(Icons.account_balance, color: Theme.of(context).primaryColor),
            const SizedBox(width: 8),
            const Text('YAseen ERP'),
          ],
        ),
        backgroundColor: Colors.white,
        foregroundColor: Colors.black87,
        elevation: 0,
        actions: [
          IconButton(
            icon: const Icon(Icons.settings),
            onPressed: () {
              Navigator.push(
                context,
                MaterialPageRoute(builder: (_) => const SettingsScreen()),
              );
            },
          ),
          PopupMenuButton<String>(
            icon: const Icon(Icons.person),
            itemBuilder: (context) => [
              PopupMenuItem(
                value: 'profile',
                child: Row(
                  children: [
                    const Icon(Icons.person_outline, size: 20),
                    const SizedBox(width: 8),
                    Text(context.read<AuthProvider>().username ?? 'المستخدم'),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
              const PopupMenuItem(
                value: 'change_password',
                child: Row(
                  children: [
                    Icon(Icons.lock_outline, size: 20),
                    SizedBox(width: 8),
                    Text('تغيير كلمة المرور'),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
              const PopupMenuItem(
                value: 'logout',
                child: Row(
                  children: [
                    Icon(Icons.logout, size: 20, color: Colors.red),
                    SizedBox(width: 8),
                    Text('تسجيل الخروج', style: TextStyle(color: Colors.red)),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ],
            onSelected: (value) {
              if (value == 'logout') _logout();
            },
          ),
        ],
      ),
      body: IndexedStack(
        index: _currentIndex,
        children: _screens,
      ),
      bottomNavigationBar: Container(
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: Colors.white,
          boxShadow: [
            BoxShadow(
              color: Colors.black.withOpacity(0.1),
              blurRadius: 10,
              offset: const Offset(0, -2),
            ),
          ],
        ),
        child: BottomNavigationBar(
          currentIndex: _currentIndex,
          onTap: (index) => setState(() => _currentIndex = index),
          type: BottomNavigationBarType.fixed,
          selectedItemColor: Theme.of(context).primaryColor,
          unselectedItemColor: Colors.grey,
          items: _navigationItems.map((item) => BottomNavigationBarItem(
            icon: Icon(item.icon),
            label: item.label,
          )).toList(),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class NavigationItem {
  final IconData icon;
  final String label;

  NavigationItem({required this.icon, required this.label});
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:go_router/go_router.dart';
import 'package:ya_seen_erp_flutter/services/api_client.dart';

class InvoiceCreateScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const InvoiceCreateScreen({super.key});

  @override
  State<InvoiceCreateScreen> createState() => _InvoiceCreateScreenState();
}

class _InvoiceCreateScreenState extends State<InvoiceCreateScreen> {
  final _formKey = GlobalKey<FormState>();
  final _customerNameController = TextEditingController();
  final _totalAmountController = TextEditingController();

  DateTime _date = DateTime.now();
  DateTime _dueDate = DateTime.now().add(const Duration(days: 30));

  Future<void> _selectDate(BuildContext context, {bool isDueDate = false}) async {
    final DateTime? picked = await showDatePicker(
      context: context,
      initialDate: isDueDate ? _dueDate : _date,
      firstDate: DateTime(2000),
      lastDate: DateTime(2101),
    );
    if (picked != null && picked != (isDueDate ? _dueDate : _date)) {
      setState(() {
        if (isDueDate) {
          _dueDate = picked;
        } else {
          _date = picked;
        }
      });
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(
        title: const Text('Create Invoice'),
      ),
      body: Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16.0),
        child: Form(
          key: _formKey,
          child: ListView(
            children: [
              TextFormField(
                controller: _customerNameController,
                decoration: const InputDecoration(labelText: 'Customer Name'),
                validator: (value) {
                  if (value == null || value.isEmpty) {
                    return 'Please enter a customer name';
                  }
                  return null;
                },
              ),
              TextFormField(
                controller: _totalAmountController,
                decoration: const InputDecoration(labelText: 'Total Amount'),
                keyboardType: TextInputType.number,
                validator: (value) {
                  if (value == null || value.isEmpty) {
                    return 'Please enter a total amount';
                  }
                  if (double.tryParse(value) == null) {
                    return 'Please enter a valid number';
                  }
                  return null;
                },
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 20),
              Row(
                children: [
                  Expanded(
                    child: Text("Date: ${_date.toLocal()}".split(' ')[0]),
                  ),
                  TextButton(
                    onPressed: () => _selectDate(context),
                    child: const Text('Select Date'),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
              Row(
                children: [
                  Expanded(
                    child: Text("Due Date: ${_dueDate.toLocal()}".split(' ')[0]),
                  ),
                  TextButton(
                    onPressed: () => _selectDate(context, isDueDate: true),
                    child: const Text('Select Due Date'),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 20),
              ElevatedButton(
                onPressed: () async {
                  if (_formKey.currentState!.validate()) {
                    try {
                      await ApiClient().createInvoice({
                        'customer_name': _customerNameController.text,
                        'total_amount': double.parse(_totalAmountController.text),
                        'date': _date.toIso8601String(),
                        'due_date': _dueDate.toIso8601String(),
                        'status': 'draft',
                      });
                      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
                        const SnackBar(content: Text('Invoice created successfully')),
                      );
                      context.go('/invoices');
                    } catch (e) {
                      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
                        SnackBar(content: Text('Failed to create invoice: $e')),
                      );
                    }
                  }
                },
                child: const Text('Create Invoice'),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:go_router/go_router.dart';
import 'package:ya_seen_erp_flutter/data/models/invoicing/invoice.dart';
import 'package:ya_seen_erp_flutter/services/api_client.dart';

class InvoiceListScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const InvoiceListScreen({super.key});

  @override
  State<InvoiceListScreen> createState() => _InvoiceListScreenState();
}

class _InvoiceListScreenState extends State<InvoiceListScreen> {
  late Future<List<Invoice>> _invoicesFuture;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _invoicesFuture = ApiClient().getInvoices();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(
        title: const Text('Invoices'),
      ),
      body: FutureBuilder<List<Invoice>>(
        future: _invoicesFuture,
        builder: (context, snapshot) {
          if (snapshot.connectionState == ConnectionState.waiting) {
            return const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator());
          } else if (snapshot.hasError) {
            return Center(child: Text('Error: ${snapshot.error}'));
          } else if (!snapshot.hasData || snapshot.data!.isEmpty) {
            return const Center(child: Text('No invoices found.'));
          } else {
            final invoices = snapshot.data!;
            return ListView.builder(
              itemCount: invoices.length,
              itemBuilder: (context, index) {
                final invoice = invoices[index];
                return ListTile(
                  title: Text('Invoice #${invoice.id}'),
                  subtitle: Text(invoice.customerName),
                  trailing: Text('\$${invoice.totalAmount.toStringAsFixed(2)}'),
                  onTap: () {
                    context.go('/invoices/${invoice.id}');
                  },
                );
              },
            );
          }
        },
      ),
      floatingActionButton: FloatingActionButton(
        onPressed: () {
          context.go('/invoices/create');
        },
        child: const Icon(Icons.add),
      ),
    );
  }
}

// lib/presentation/screens/invoicing/invoices/create_invoice_screen.dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:provider/provider.dart';
import 'package:decimal/decimal.dart';
import 'package:intl/intl.dart';
import '../../../providers/invoicing_provider.dart';
import '../../../providers/customer_provider.dart';
import '../../../providers/product_provider.dart';
import '../../../domain/entities/invoice.dart';
import '../../../domain/entities/customer.dart';
import '../../../domain/entities/product.dart';
import '../../../widgets/shared/loading_indicator.dart';
import '../../../widgets/shared/customer_search_field.dart';
import '../../../widgets/shared/product_search_field.dart';

class CreateInvoiceScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const CreateInvoiceScreen({super.key});

  @override
  State<CreateInvoiceScreen> createState() => _CreateInvoiceScreenState();
}

class _CreateInvoiceScreenState extends State<CreateInvoiceScreen> {
  final _formKey = GlobalKey<FormState>();
  
  // معلومات الفاتورة
  Customer? _selectedCustomer;
  String? _selectedBranchId;
  String? _selectedSiteId;
  String _currency = 'USD';
  String _paymentCurrency = 'USD';
  String _paymentType = 'cash';
  String? _fundId;
  bool _isTaxInclusive = false;
  final _notesController = TextEditingController();

  // البنود
  List<InvoiceLine> _lines = [];
  final List<Product> _products = [];

  // الإجماليات
  Decimal _subtotal = Decimal.zero;
  Decimal _taxAmount = Decimal.zero;
  Decimal _total = Decimal.zero;
  Decimal _totalWithTax = Decimal.zero;
  Map<String, Decimal> _taxBreakdown = {};

  bool _isLoading = false;
  bool _isSaving = false;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _loadData();
    _addLine();
  }

  Future<void> _loadData() async {
    setState(() => _isLoading = true);
    try {
      await Future.wait([
        context.read<CustomerProvider>().loadCustomers(),
        context.read<ProductProvider>().loadProducts(),
      ]);
    } catch (e) {
      // تجاهل الأخطاء في التحميل الأولي
    } finally {
      setState(() => _isLoading = false);
    }
  }

  void _addLine() {
    setState(() {
      _lines.add(InvoiceLine(
        lineId: 'line_${DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch}',
        productCode: '',
        productName: '',
        quantity: Decimal.one,
        unitPrice: Decimal.zero,
        total: Decimal.zero,
        currency: _currency,
        taxRate: Decimal.zero,
        taxAmount: Decimal.zero,
        totalWithTax: Decimal.zero,
      ));
      _calculateTotals();
    });
  }

  void _removeLine(String lineId) {
    if (_lines.length <= 1) {
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        const SnackBar(
          content: Text('يجب أن يكون هناك بند واحد على الأقل'),
          backgroundColor: Colors.orange,
        ),
      );
      return;
    }
    setState(() {
      _lines.removeWhere((line) => line.lineId == lineId);
      _calculateTotals();
    });
  }

  void _updateLine(String lineId, InvoiceLine updatedLine) {
    setState(() {
      final index = _lines.indexWhere((line) => line.lineId == lineId);
      if (index != -1) {
        _lines[index] = updatedLine;
        _calculateTotals();
      }
    });
  }

  void _calculateTotals() {
    _subtotal = _lines.fold(Decimal.zero, (sum, line) => sum + line.total);
    _taxAmount = _lines.fold(Decimal.zero, (sum, line) => sum + line.taxAmount);
    _total = _subtotal;
    _totalWithTax = _subtotal + _taxAmount;
    
    // تجميع تفصيل الضرائب
    _taxBreakdown = {};
    for (var line in _lines) {
      for (var entry in line.taxBreakdown.entries) {
        _taxBreakdown[entry.key] = (_taxBreakdown[entry.key] ?? Decimal.zero) + entry.value;
      }
    }
  }

  Future<void> _saveDraft() async {
    if (!_validateForm()) return;

    setState(() => _isSaving = true);

    try {
      final provider = context.read<InvoicingProvider>();
      final invoice = await provider.createInvoice(
        customerId: _selectedCustomer!.id,
        customerName: _selectedCustomer!.name,
        customerBranchId: _selectedBranchId,
        siteId: _selectedSiteId,
        currency: _currency,
        paymentCurrency: _paymentCurrency,
        paymentType: _paymentType,
        fundId: _fundId,
        lines: _lines.where((l) => l.productCode.isNotEmpty).toList(),
        notes: _notesController.text.trim(),
        isTaxInclusive: _isTaxInclusive,
        createdBy: 'system',
      );

      if (mounted) {
        Navigator.pop(context, true);
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          const SnackBar(
            content: Text('✅ تم حفظ الفاتورة كمسودة'),
            backgroundColor: Colors.green,
          ),
        );
      }
    } catch (e) {
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        SnackBar(
          content: Text('❌ خطأ: $e'),
          backgroundColor: Colors.red,
        ),
      );
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _isSaving = false);
    }
  }

  Future<void> _saveAndPost() async {
    if (!_validateForm()) return;

    setState(() => _isSaving = true);

    try {
      final provider = context.read<InvoicingProvider>();
      final invoice = await provider.createInvoice(
        customerId: _selectedCustomer!.id,
        customerName: _selectedCustomer!.name,
        customerBranchId: _selectedBranchId,
        siteId: _selectedSiteId,
        currency: _currency,
        paymentCurrency: _paymentCurrency,
        paymentType: _paymentType,
        fundId: _fundId,
        lines: _lines.where((l) => l.productCode.isNotEmpty).toList(),
        notes: _notesController.text.trim(),
        isTaxInclusive: _isTaxInclusive,
        createdBy: 'system',
      );

      // ترحيل الفاتورة مباشرة
      await provider.postInvoice(invoice.id, 'system');

      if (mounted) {
        Navigator.pop(context, true);
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          const SnackBar(
            content: Text('✅ تم ترحيل الفاتورة بنجاح'),
            backgroundColor: Colors.green,
          ),
        );
      }
    } catch (e) {
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        SnackBar(
          content: Text('❌ خطأ: $e'),
          backgroundColor: Colors.red,
        ),
      );
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _isSaving = false);
    }
  }

  bool _validateForm() {
    if (!_formKey.currentState!.validate()) return false;

    if (_selectedCustomer == null) {
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        const SnackBar(
          content: Text('يجب اختيار عميل'),
          backgroundColor: Colors.orange,
        ),
      );
      return false;
    }

    final validLines = _lines.where((l) => l.productCode.isNotEmpty).toList();
    if (validLines.isEmpty) {
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        const SnackBar(
          content: Text('يجب إضافة بند واحد على الأقل'),
          backgroundColor: Colors.orange,
        ),
      );
      return false;
    }

    if (_subtotal <= Decimal.zero) {
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        const SnackBar(
          content: Text('المجموع يجب أن يكون أكبر من صفر'),
          backgroundColor: Colors.orange,
        ),
      );
      return false;
    }

    return true;
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(
        title: const Text('فاتورة جديدة'),
        backgroundColor: Colors.blue.shade700,
        foregroundColor: Colors.white,
        elevation: 0,
        actions: [
          TextButton.icon(
            onPressed: _isSaving ? null : _saveDraft,
            icon: const Icon(Icons.save, color: Colors.white),
            label: const Text('مسودة', style: TextStyle(color: Colors.white)),
          ),
          ElevatedButton.icon(
            onPressed: _isSaving ? null : _saveAndPost,
            icon: const Icon(Icons.check_circle),
            label: const Text('ترحيل'),
            style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
              backgroundColor: Colors.green,
              foregroundColor: Colors.white,
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(width: 8),
        ],
      ),
      body: _isLoading || _isSaving
          ? const LoadingIndicator(message: 'جاري المعالجة...')
          : Form(
              key: _formKey,
              child: SingleChildScrollView(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
                child: Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                  children: [
                    // معلومات الفاتورة
                    _buildInvoiceInfo(),
                    const SizedBox(height: 16),
                    // اختيار العميل
                    _buildCustomerSelection(),
                    const SizedBox(height: 16),
                    // بنود الفاتورة
                    _buildLinesSection(),
                    const SizedBox(height: 16),
                    // ملخص الضرائب
                    if (_taxAmount > Decimal.zero) _buildTaxSummary(),
                    const SizedBox(height: 16),
                    // الإجماليات
                    _buildTotals(),
                    const SizedBox(height: 16),
                    // ملاحظات
                    _buildNotes(),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildInvoiceInfo() {
    return Card(
      elevation: 2,
      child: Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
        child: Column(
          children: [
            Row(
              children: [
                Expanded(
                  child: DropdownButtonFormField<String>(
                    value: _currency,
                    decoration: const InputDecoration(
                      labelText: 'عملة الفاتورة',
                      border: OutlineInputBorder(),
                      prefixIcon: Icon(Icons.currency_exchange),
                    ),
                    items: const [
                      DropdownMenuItem(value: 'USD', child: Text('دولار أمريكي')),
                      DropdownMenuItem(value: 'LBP', child: Text('ليرة لبنانية')),
                      DropdownMenuItem(value: 'EUR', child: Text('يورو')),
                    ],
                    onChanged: (value) => setState(() => _currency = value!),
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(width: 16),
                Expanded(
                  child: DropdownButtonFormField<String>(
                    value: _paymentCurrency,
                    decoration: const InputDecoration(
                      labelText: 'عملة الدفع',
                      border: OutlineInputBorder(),

                    ],
                    onChanged: (value) => setState(() => _paymentCurrency = value!),
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 16),
            Row(
              children: [
                Expanded(

                    value: _paymentType,

                      labelText: 'طريقة الدفع',
                      border: OutlineInputBorder(),

                Expanded(

                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildCustomerSelection() {
    return Card(

      child: Padding(

          children: [
            const Text(
              'معلومات العميل',
              style: TextStyle(fontSize: 14, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),

            CustomerSearchField(

                    if (_selectedCustomer!.code != null) ...[
                      const SizedBox(height: 4),
                      Row(

                          const Icon(Icons.code, size: 16),
                          const SizedBox(width: 8),
                          Text(_selectedCustomer!.code!),
                        ],

                  ],

  Widget _buildLinesSection() {
    return Card(
      elevation: 2,
      child: Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: [
            const Row(
              children: [
                Text(
                  'بنود الفاتورة',
                  style: TextStyle(fontSize: 14, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
                ),
                Spacer(),
                Text(
                  'يجب إضافة بند واحد على الأقل',
                  style: TextStyle(fontSize: 11, color: Colors.grey),
                ),
              ],
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 8),
            // رأس الجدول
            Container(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8, vertical: 10),
              color: Colors.grey.shade100,
              child: const Row(
                children: [
                  Expanded(flex: 2, child: Text('المنتج', style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold))),
                  Expanded(flex: 0.8, child: Text('الكمية', style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold))),
                  Expanded(flex: 1, child: Text('سعر الوحدة', style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold))),
                  Expanded(flex: 1, child: Text('الإجمالي', style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold))),
                  SizedBox(width: 40, child: Text('', style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold))),
                ],
              ),
            ),
            // الأسطر
            ..._lines.map((line) => _buildLineRow(line)),
            // زر إضافة بند
            InkWell(
              onTap: _addLine,
              child: Container(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: Colors.grey.shade50,
                  borderRadius: const BorderRadius.vertical(bottom: Radius.circular(4)),
                ),
                child: const Row(
                  mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
                  children: [
                    Icon(Icons.add_circle_outline, size: 20, color: Colors.blue),
                    SizedBox(width: 8),
                    Text('إضافة بند جديد', style: TextStyle(color: Colors.blue)),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildLineRow(InvoiceLine line) {
    return Container(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8, vertical: 4),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        border: Border(bottom: BorderSide(color: Colors.grey.shade200)),
      ),
      child: Row(
        children: [
          Expanded(
            flex: 2,
            child: ProductSearchField(
              onSelected: (product) {
                _updateLine(line.lineId, line.copyWith(
                  productCode: product.code,
                  productName: product.name,
                  unitPrice: product.unitPrice,
                  total: line.quantity * product.unitPrice,
                ));
              },
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(width: 8),
          Expanded(
            flex: 0.8,
            child: TextFormField(
              initialValue: line.quantity.toString(),
              keyboardType: TextInputType.number,
              decoration: const InputDecoration(
                border: OutlineInputBorder(),
                contentPadding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8),
              ),
              onChanged: (value) {
                final qty = Decimal.tryParse(value) ?? Decimal.one;
                final unitPrice = line.unitPrice;
                _updateLine(line.lineId, line.copyWith(
                  quantity: qty,
                  total: qty * unitPrice,
                ));
              },
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(width: 8),
          Expanded(
            flex: 1,
            child: TextFormField(
              initialValue: line.unitPrice.toString(),
              keyboardType: TextInputType.number,
              decoration: const InputDecoration(
                border: OutlineInputBorder(),
                contentPadding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8),
              ),
              onChanged: (value) {
                final price = Decimal.tryParse(value) ?? Decimal.zero;
                _updateLine(line.lineId, line.copyWith(
                  unitPrice: price,
                  total: line.quantity * price,
                ));
              },
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(width: 8),
          Expanded(
            flex: 1,
            child: Text(
              '${line.total.toStringAsFixed(2)} ${_currency}',
              style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(width: 8),
          SizedBox(
            width: 40,
            child: IconButton(
              icon: const Icon(Icons.delete_outline, size: 20, color: Colors.red),
              onPressed: _lines.length > 1 ? () => _removeLine(line.lineId) : null,
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildTaxSummary() {
    return Card(
      elevation: 2,
      color: Colors.orange.shade50,
      child: Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: [
            const Text(
              'تفصيل الضرائب',
              style: TextStyle(fontSize: 14, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 8),
            ..._taxBreakdown.entries.map((entry) {
              return Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 2),
                child: Row(
                  children: [
                    Text(entry.key, style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12, color: Colors.grey.shade700)),
                    const Spacer(),
                    Text('${entry.value.toStringAsFixed(2)} ${_currency}'),
                  ],
                ),
              );
            }),
            const Divider(),
            Row(
              children: [
                const Text('إجمالي الضريبة', style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold)),
                const Spacer(),
                Text(
                  '${_taxAmount.toStringAsFixed(2)} ${_currency}',
                  style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, color: Colors.orange),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildTotals() {
    return Card(
      elevation: 2,
      color: Colors.blue.shade50,
      child: Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
        child: Row(
          mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceAround,
          children: [
            _buildTotalItem('المجموع الفرعي', _subtotal),
            _buildTotalItem('الضريبة', _taxAmount, color: Colors.orange),
            _buildTotalItem('الإجمالي', _totalWithTax, isBold: true),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildTotalItem(String label, Decimal amount, {Color? color, bool isBold = false}) {
    return Column(
      children: [
        Text(label, style: TextStyle(fontSize: 11, color: Colors.grey.shade600)),
        const SizedBox(height: 4),
        Text(
          '${amount.toStringAsFixed(2)} ${_currency}',
          style: TextStyle(
            fontSize: isBold ? 18 : 14,
            fontWeight: isBold ? FontWeight.bold : FontWeight.normal,
            color: color ?? (isBold ? Colors.blue : Colors.black),
          ),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }

  Widget _buildNotes() {
    return Card(
      elevation: 2,
      child: Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
        child: TextFormField(
          controller: _notesController,
          decoration: const InputDecoration(
            labelText: 'ملاحظات (اختياري)',
            border: OutlineInputBorder(),
            prefixIcon: Icon(Icons.description),
          ),
          maxLines: 3,
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

class InvoiceDetailScreen extends StatefulWidget {

  const InvoiceDetailScreen({super.key, required this.invoice});

  @override
  State<InvoiceDetailScreen> createState() => _InvoiceDetailScreenState();

class _InvoiceDetailScreenState extends State<InvoiceDetailScreen> {
  bool _isLoading = false;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {

                  _buildCustomerInfo(),
                  const SizedBox(height: 16),
                  // البنود
                  _buildLinesTable(),
                  const SizedBox(height: 16),
                  // ملخص الضرائب
                  _buildTaxSummary(),

                  // الإجماليات
                  _buildTotals(),
                  if (widget.invoice.notes != null) ...[
                    const SizedBox(height: 16),

  }

  Widget _buildBasicInfo() {

            const SizedBox(height: 8),
            Row(
              children: [
                Expanded(
                  child: _buildInfoRow('الحالة', widget.invoice.statusDisplay),
                ),
                Expanded(
                  child: _buildInfoRow('العملة', widget.invoice.currency),
                ),
              ],

            const SizedBox(height: 8),
            Row(
              children: [
                Expanded(
                  child: _buildInfoRow('طريقة الدفع', _getPaymentTypeDisplay(widget.invoice.paymentType)),

                Expanded(
                  child: _buildInfoRow('عملة الدفع', widget.invoice.paymentCurrency),

              ],

      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildInfoRow(String label, String value) {
    return Column(

      children: [
        Text(label, style: TextStyle(fontSize: 11, color: Colors.grey.shade600)),
        const SizedBox(height: 2),
        Text(value, style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 14, fontWeight: FontWeight.w500)),
      ],
    );
  }

  Widget _buildCustomerInfo() {
    return Card(
      elevation: 2,
      child: Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: [
            const Text(
              'معلومات العميل',
              style: TextStyle(fontSize: 14, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 8),
            Row(
              children: [
                const Icon(Icons.person, size: 16, color: Colors.grey),
                const SizedBox(width: 8),
                Text(widget.invoice.customerName),
              ],
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 4),
            Row(
              children: [
                const Icon(Icons.code, size: 16, color: Colors.grey),
                const SizedBox(width: 8),
                Text(widget.invoice.customerId),
              ],
            ),
            if (widget.invoice.hasCustomerBranch) ...[
              const SizedBox(height: 4),
              Row(
                children: [
                  const Icon(Icons.business, size: 16, color: Colors.grey),
                  const SizedBox(width: 8),
                  Text('فرع: ${widget.invoice.customerBranchName ?? widget.invoice.customerBranchCode}'),
                ],
              ),
            ],
            if (widget.invoice.siteName != null) ...[
              const SizedBox(height: 4),
              Row(
                children: [
                  const Icon(Icons.location_on, size: 16, color: Colors.grey),
                  const SizedBox(width: 8),
                  Text('الموقع: ${widget.invoice.siteName}'),
                ],
              ),
            ],
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildLinesTable() {
    return Card(
      elevation: 2,
      child: Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: [
            const Text(
              'بنود الفاتورة',
              style: TextStyle(fontSize: 14, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 8),
            Table(
              border: TableBorder.all(color: Colors.grey.shade300),
              columnWidths: const {
                0: FlexColumnWidth(2),
                1: FlexColumnWidth(0.8),
                2: FlexColumnWidth(1),
                3: FlexColumnWidth(1),
                4: FlexColumnWidth(1),
              },
              children: [
                // رأس الجدول
                const TableRow(
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(color: Colors.grey.shade200),
                  children: [
                    Padding(padding: EdgeInsets.all(8), child: Text('المنتج', style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold))),
                    Padding(padding: EdgeInsets.all(8), child: Text('الكمية', style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold))),
                    Padding(padding: EdgeInsets.all(8), child: Text('سعر الوحدة', style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold))),
                    Padding(padding: EdgeInsets.all(8), child: Text('الضريبة', style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold))),
                    Padding(padding: EdgeInsets.all(8), child: Text('الإجمالي', style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold))),
                  ],
                ),
                // الأسطر
                ...widget.invoice.lines.map((line) => TableRow(
                  children: [
                    Padding(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(8),
                      child: Column(
                        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                        children: [
                          Text(line.productCode, style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold)),
                          Text(line.productName, style: TextStyle(fontSize: 11, color: Colors.grey.shade600)),
                        ],
                      ),
                    ),
                    Padding(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(8),
                      child: Text(line.quantity.toString()),
                    ),
                    Padding(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(8),
                      child: Text('${line.unitPrice.toStringAsFixed(2)} ${line.currency}'),
                    ),
                    Padding(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(8),
                      child: line.hasTax
                          ? Text(
                              '${line.taxAmount.toStringAsFixed(2)}',
                              style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.orange),
                            )
                          : const Text('-'),
                    ),
                    Padding(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(8),
                      child: Text(
                        '${line.total.toStringAsFixed(2)} ${line.currency}',
                        style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                )),
                // سطر الإجمالي
                TableRow(
                  decoration: const BoxDecoration(color: Colors.grey.shade100),
                  children: [
                    const Padding(
                      padding: EdgeInsets.all(8),
                      child: Text('الإجمالي', style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold)),
                    ),
                    const Padding(padding: EdgeInsets.all(8), child: Text('')),
                    const Padding(padding: EdgeInsets.all(8), child: Text('')),
                    Padding(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(8),
                      child: Text(
                        widget.invoice.taxAmount.toStringAsFixed(2),
                        style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, color: Colors.orange),
                      ),
                    ),
                    Padding(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(8),
                      child: Text(
                        widget.invoice.totalWithTax.toStringAsFixed(2),
                        style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, color: Colors.blue),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildTaxSummary() {
    if (!widget.invoice.hasTax) return const SizedBox.shrink();

    return Card(
      elevation: 2,
      color: Colors.orange.shade50,
      child: Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: [
            const Text(
              'تفصيل الضرائب',
              style: TextStyle(fontSize: 14, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 8),
            ...widget.invoice.taxBreakdown.entries.map((entry) {
              return Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 2),
                child: Row(
                  children: [
                    Text(
                      entry.key,
                      style: TextStyle(fontSize: 12, color: Colors.grey.shade700),
                    ),
                    const Spacer(),
                    Text(
                      '${entry.value.toStringAsFixed(2)} ${widget.invoice.currency}',
                      style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w500),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              );
            }),
            const Divider(),
            Row(
              children: [
                const Text(
                  'إجمالي الضريبة',
                  style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
                ),
                const Spacer(),
                Text(
                  '${widget.invoice.taxAmount.toStringAsFixed(2)} ${widget.invoice.currency}',
                  style: const TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, color: Colors.orange),
                ),
              ],
            ),
            if (widget.invoice.isTaxInclusive) ...[
              const SizedBox(height: 4),
              const Text(
                'الضريبة شاملة في السعر',
                style: TextStyle(fontSize: 11, color: Colors.grey),
              ),
            ],
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildTotals() {
    return Card(
      elevation: 2,
      color: Colors.blue.shade50,
      child: Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
        child: Column(
          children: [
            Row(
              mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceAround,
              children: [
                _buildTotalItem('المجموع الفرعي', widget.invoice.subtotal),
                _buildTotalItem('الضريبة', widget.invoice.taxAmount, color: Colors.orange),
                _buildTotalItem('الإجمالي شامل الضريبة', widget.invoice.totalWithTax, isBold: true),
              ],
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildTotalItem(String label, Decimal amount, {Color? color, bool isBold = false}) {
    return Column(
      children: [
        Text(label, style: TextStyle(fontSize: 11, color: Colors.grey.shade600)),
        const SizedBox(height: 4),
        Text(
          '${amount.toStringAsFixed(2)} ${widget.invoice.currency}',
          style: TextStyle(
            fontSize: isBold ? 18 : 14,
            fontWeight: isBold ? FontWeight.bold : FontWeight.normal,
            color: color ?? (isBold ? Colors.blue : Colors.black),
          ),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }

  Widget _buildNotes() {
    return Card(
      elevation: 2,
      color: Colors.grey.shade50,
      child: Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: [
            const Text(
              'ملاحظات',
              style: TextStyle(fontSize: 14, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 8),
            Text(widget.invoice.notes!),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildPostedInfo() {
    return Card(
      elevation: 2,
      color: Colors.green.shade50,
      child: Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
        child: Row(
          children: [
            const Icon(Icons.check_circle, color: Colors.green),
            const SizedBox(width: 12),
            Expanded(
              child: Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: [
                  const Text(
                    'تم ترحيل الفاتورة',
                    style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
                  ),
                  Text(
                    'تم الترحيل في ${DateFormat('yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm').format(widget.invoice.postedAt!)} بواسطة ${widget.invoice.postedBy ?? 'نظام'}',
                    style: TextStyle(fontSize: 11, color: Colors.grey.shade700),
                  ),
                  if (widget.invoice.journalEntryId != null)
                    Text(
                      'رقم القيد المحاسبي: ${widget.invoice.journalEntryId}',
                      style: TextStyle(fontSize: 11, color: Colors.grey.shade700),
                    ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  String _getPaymentTypeDisplay(String type) {
    switch (type) {
      case 'cash':
        return 'نقدي';
      case 'credit':
        return 'آجل';
      case 'check':
        return 'شيك';
      case 'transfer':
        return 'تحويل بنكي';
      default:
        return type;
    }
  }

  // =========================================================================
  // الإجراءات
  // =========================================================================

  Future<void> _postInvoice() async {
    final confirm = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      builder: (context) => AlertDialog(
        title: const Text('ترحيل الفاتورة'),
        content: const Text('هل أنت متأكد من رغبتك في ترحيل هذه الفاتورة؟'),
        actions: [
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context, false),
            child: const Text('إلغاء'),
          ),
          ElevatedButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context, true),
            child: const Text('ترحيل'),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );

    if (confirm != true) return;

    setState(() => _isLoading = true);
    try {
      final provider = context.read<InvoicingProvider>();
      await provider.postInvoice(widget.invoice.id, 'system');
      
      if (mounted) {
        Navigator.pop(context, true);
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          const SnackBar(
            content: Text('✅ تم ترحيل الفاتورة بنجاح'),
            backgroundColor: Colors.green,
          ),
        );
      }
    } catch (e) {
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        SnackBar(
          content: Text('❌ خطأ في الترحيل: $e'),
          backgroundColor: Colors.red,
        ),
      );
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _isLoading = false);
    }
  }

  Future<void> _cancelInvoice() async {
    final confirm = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      builder: (context) => AlertDialog(
        title: const Text('إلغاء الفاتورة'),
        content: const Text('هل أنت متأكد من رغبتك في إلغاء هذه الفاتورة؟'),
        actions: [
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context, false),
            child: const Text('إلغاء'),
          ),
          ElevatedButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context, true),
            style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(backgroundColor: Colors.red),
            child: const Text('إلغاء الفاتورة'),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );

    if (confirm != true) return;

    setState(() => _isLoading = true);
    try {
      final provider = context.read<InvoicingProvider>();
      await provider.cancelInvoice(widget.invoice.id, 'تم الإلغاء', 'system');
      
      if (mounted) {
        Navigator.pop(context, true);
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          const SnackBar(
            content: Text('✅ تم إلغاء الفاتورة'),
            backgroundColor: Colors.orange,
          ),
        );
      }
    } catch (e) {
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        SnackBar(
          content: Text('❌ خطأ في الإلغاء: $e'),
          backgroundColor: Colors.red,
        ),
      );
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _isLoading = false);
    }
  }

  Future<void> _deleteDraft() async {
    final confirm = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      builder: (context) => AlertDialog(
        title: const Text('حذف الفاتورة'),
        content: const Text('هل أنت متأكد من رغبتك في حذف هذه الفاتورة المسودة؟'),
        actions: [
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context, false),
            child: const Text('إلغاء'),
          ),
          ElevatedButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(context, true),
            style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(backgroundColor: Colors.red),
            child: const Text('حذف'),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );

    if (confirm != true) return;

    setState(() => _isLoading = true);
    try {
      final provider = context.read<InvoicingProvider>();
      await provider.deleteDraftInvoice(widget.invoice.id);
      
      if (mounted) {
        Navigator.pop(context, true);
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          const SnackBar(
            content: Text('✅ تم حذف الفاتورة'),
            backgroundColor: Colors.green,
          ),
        );
      }
    } catch (e) {
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        SnackBar(
          content: Text('❌ خطأ في الحذف: $e'),
          backgroundColor: Colors.red,
        ),
      );
    } finally {
      if (mounted) setState(() => _isLoading = false);
    }
  }

  void _printInvoice() {
    // تنفيذ طباعة الفاتورة
    ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
      const SnackBar(content: Text('جاري تجهيز الفاتورة للطباعة...')),
    );
  }
}

// lib/presentation/screens/invoicing/invoices/invoices_screen.dart
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:provider/provider.dart';
import 'package:intl/intl.dart';
import '../../../providers/invoicing_provider.dart';
import '../../../domain/entities/invoice.dart';
import '../../../widgets/shared/loading_indicator.dart';
import 'create_invoice_screen.dart';
import 'invoice_detail_screen.dart';

class InvoicesScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const InvoicesScreen({super.key});

  @override
  State<InvoicesScreen> createState() => _InvoicesScreenState();
}

class _InvoicesScreenState extends State<InvoicesScreen> {
  String _statusFilter = 'all';
  String _searchQuery = '';

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _loadData();
  }

  void _loadData() {
    WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
      context.read<InvoicingProvider>().loadInvoices();
    });
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(
        title: const Text('الفواتير'),
        centerTitle: true,
        bottom: PreferredSize(
          preferredSize: const Size.fromHeight(60),
          child: Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(8),
            child: TextField(
              decoration: const InputDecoration(
                hintText: 'بحث عن فاتورة...',
                prefixIcon: Icon(Icons.search),
                border: OutlineInputBorder(),
                contentPadding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 8),
              ),
              onChanged: (value) => setState(() => _searchQuery = value),
            ),
          ),
        ),
        actions: [
          IconButton(
            icon: const Icon(Icons.refresh),
            onPressed: _loadData,
            tooltip: 'تحديث',
          ),
        ],
      ),
      body: Consumer<InvoicingProvider>(
        builder: (context, provider, child) {
          if (provider.isLoading && provider.invoices.isEmpty) {
            return const LoadingIndicator(message: 'جاري تحميل الفواتير...');
          }

          if (provider.error != null && provider.invoices.isEmpty) {
            return _buildErrorWidget(provider.error!);
          }

          final filtered = _getFilteredInvoices(provider.invoices);

          if (filtered.isEmpty) {
            return _buildEmptyWidget();
          }

          return Column(
            children: [
              // فلاتر الحالة
              _buildStatusFilter(),
              // قائمة الفواتير
              Expanded(
                child: ListView.builder(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.all(8),
                  itemCount: filtered.length,
                  itemBuilder: (context, index) {
                    final invoice = filtered[index];
                    return _buildInvoiceCard(invoice);
                  },
                ),
              ),
            ],
          );
        },
      ),
      floatingActionButton: FloatingActionButton(
        onPressed: () => _navigateToCreate(),
        child: const Icon(Icons.add),
        tooltip: 'فاتورة جديدة',
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildStatusFilter() {
    final statuses = [
      {'key': 'all', 'label': 'الكل'},
      {'key': 'draft', 'label': 'مسودة'},
      {'key': 'posted', 'label': 'مرحلة'},
      {'key': 'cancelled', 'label': 'ملغاة'},
    ];

    return Container(
      height: 50,
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8),
      child: ListView.builder(
        scrollDirection: Axis.horizontal,
        itemCount: statuses.length,
        itemBuilder: (context, index) {
          final status = statuses[index];
          final isSelected = _statusFilter == status['key'];
          return Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 4),
            child: FilterChip(
              label: Text(status['label']!),
              selected: isSelected,
              onSelected: (_) => setState(() => _statusFilter = status['key']!),
              backgroundColor: Colors.grey.shade200,
              selectedColor: Colors.blue.shade100,
              checkmarkColor: Colors.blue,
            ),
          );
        },
      ),
    );
  }

  List<Invoice> _getFilteredInvoices(List<Invoice> invoices) {
    var filtered = invoices;

    // فلترة حسب الحالة
    if (_statusFilter != 'all') {
      filtered = filtered.where((i) => i.status == _statusFilter).toList();
    }

    // البحث
    if (_searchQuery.isNotEmpty) {
      final query = _searchQuery.toLowerCase();
      filtered = filtered.where((i) =>
          (i.number?.toLowerCase().contains(query) ?? false) ||
          i.customerName.toLowerCase().contains(query) ||
          (i.customerBranchName?.toLowerCase().contains(query) ?? false));
    }

    return filtered;
  }

  Widget _buildInvoiceCard(Invoice invoice) {
    return Card(
      margin: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 4, horizontal: 8),
      elevation: 2,
      child: InkWell(
        onTap: () => _navigateToDetail(invoice),
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
        child: Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
          child: Column(
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
            children: [
              // الصف العلوي
              Row(
                children: [
                  Container(
                    padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8, vertical: 4),
                    decoration: BoxDecoration(
                      color: invoice.statusColor.withOpacity(0.2),
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
                    ),
                    child: Text(
                      invoice.statusDisplay,
                      style: TextStyle(
                        color: invoice.statusColor,
                        fontSize: 11,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(width: 8),
                  Text(
                    invoice.number ?? 'مسودة',
                    style: const TextStyle(
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                      fontSize: 14,
                    ),
                  ),
                  const Spacer(),
                  Text(
                    DateFormat('yyyy-MM-dd').format(invoice.date),
                    style: TextStyle(fontSize: 11, color: Colors.grey.shade600),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 8),
              // العميل
              Row(
                children: [
                  const Icon(Icons.person, size: 16, color: Colors.grey),
                  const SizedBox(width: 4),
                  Expanded(
                    child: Text(
                      invoice.customerName,
                      style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 13),
                      maxLines: 1,
                      overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                    ),
                  ),
                  if (invoice.hasCustomerBranch)
                    Container(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 6, vertical: 2),
                      decoration: BoxDecoration(
                        color: Colors.purple.shade50,
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
                        border: Border.all(color: Colors.purple.shade200),
                      ),
                      child: Text(
                        invoice.customerBranchName ?? 'فرع',
                        style: TextStyle(
                          fontSize: 10,
                          color: Colors.purple.shade700,
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                ],
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 8),
              // المبالغ
              Row(
                children: [
                  Expanded(
                    child: Text(
                      'المجموع: ${invoice.total.toStringAsFixed(2)} ${invoice.currency}',
                      style: const TextStyle(
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                        fontSize: 14,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                  if (invoice.hasTax)
                    Container(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 6, vertical: 2),
                      decoration: BoxDecoration(
                        color: Colors.orange.shade50,
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
                      ),
                      child: Text(
                        '+ ضريبة: ${invoice.taxAmount.toStringAsFixed(2)}',
                        style: TextStyle(
                          fontSize: 11,
                          color: Colors.orange.shade700,
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                  const SizedBox(width: 8),
                  Text(
                    'عدد البنود: ${invoice.lines.length}',
                    style: TextStyle(fontSize: 11, color: Colors.grey.shade600),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
              if (invoice.notes != null) ...[
                const SizedBox(height: 4),
                Text(
                  invoice.notes!,
                  style: TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 11,
                    color: Colors.grey.shade600,
                    fontStyle: FontStyle.italic,
                  ),
                  maxLines: 1,
                  overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                ),
              ],
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildErrorWidget(String error) {
    return Center(
      child: Column(
        mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
        children: [
          const Icon(Icons.error_outline, size: 64, color: Colors.red),
          const SizedBox(height: 16),
          Text(error, style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.red)),
          const SizedBox(height: 16),
          ElevatedButton(
            onPressed: _loadData,
            child: const Text('إعادة المحاولة'),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildEmptyWidget() {
    return Center(
      child: Column(
        mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
        children: [
          Icon(Icons.receipt_long, size: 64, color: Colors.grey.shade400),
          const SizedBox(height: 16),
          const Text(
            'لا توجد فواتير',
            style: TextStyle(fontSize: 18, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 8),
          Text(
            _statusFilter != 'all' ? 'لا توجد فواتير بهذه الحالة' : 'قم بإنشاء فاتورة جديدة',
            style: TextStyle(color: Colors.grey.shade600),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 16),
          if (_statusFilter != 'all')
            TextButton(
              onPressed: () => setState(() => _statusFilter = 'all'),
              child: const Text('عرض جميع الفواتير'),
            ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  void _navigateToCreate() {
    Navigator.push(
      context,
      MaterialPageRoute(
        builder: (context) => const CreateInvoiceScreen(),
      ),
    ).then((_) => _loadData());
  }

  void _navigateToDetail(Invoice invoice) {
    Navigator.push(
      context,
      MaterialPageRoute(
        builder: (context) => InvoiceDetailScreen(invoice: invoice),
      ),
    ).then((_) => _loadData());
  }
}
